jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Web Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Web Infrastructure team builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients, including client architecture, performance, reliability, and shared design systems.

As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the team through the evolution from Notion Clients. You’ll set strategy, develop senior engineers and managers, and partner across Notion to make the product faster, more reliable, and easier to build.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - You'll build and manage a diverse and inclusive team of engineers and managers working on core parts of Notion's architecture. You'll create a healthy environment in your team that embodies Notion's values.

 - You'll recruit, coach, and develop engineers. You'll ensure engineers are regularly receiving feedback and making progress on personal and professional goals.

 - You'll facilitate planning—the prioritization, sequencing, and staffing of work—for your team.

 - You'll be responsible for maintaining a high-quality bar for everything your team ships.

 - You'll own execution in your team to develop a steady cadence of delivering value to your users.

 - You'll work with others to shape how Notion's engineering organization works. You'll help develop our technical practices, recruiting and onboarding strategy, planning and prioritization process, and more.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - You have managed senior engineering teams and managers, and have experience in scaling teams.

 - You have built, or are committed to building, diverse and inclusive teams.

 - You create team environments that are at once collaborative, empowering, supportive, and challenging—ones where engineers do their best work.

 - You have a sufficiently deep background in product and technology that you can ask the right questions of your team, balance product, tech, and people concerns, and make hard tradeoffs.

 - You think rigorously. You're prepared to tackle the toughest technical problems, understand trade-offs, and enable teams to make decisions and progress.

 - You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and change, especially around organizational structure and the boundaries of your role. You enjoy jumping into whatever areas need attention and learning as-you-go.

 - You value empathetic and direct communication, particularly when giving and receiving feedback.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have managed engineering teams at startups before, particularly during periods of rapid growth and organizational change.

 - You have experience rolling out engineering and management practices and processes—e.g., code review, performance reviews, and levels and ladders—where they didn't exist before.

 - You've managed teams that are across multiple offices.

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $255,000 - $300,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Cuisinier (H/F)
jobs.description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Venez nous découvrir

jobs.title: Ingénieur DevOps   (H/F)
jobs.description:
Dans le cadre de l'automatisation de l'intégration et du déploiement des applications informatiques de nos clients, tu seras en charge de :
- Construire, maintenir en conditions opérationnelles et améliorer les différentes plateformes d'intégration et déploiement continu
- Définir les processus de déploiements
- Déployer des releases applicatives sur les environnements de test et de production
- Assurer la disponibilité des applications au quotidien.

- Investiguer et corriger les anomalies et faits techniques
- Intégrer, maintenir, administrer et documenter les outils de déploiement, automatiser les tâches courantes
- Administrer le traitement des tickets d'incidents
- Appliquer les changements validés sur les environnements Linux, Oracle
- Intégrer et valider les patchs ou les correctifs fournis par l'équipe de réalisation.
- Accompagnement des équipes de développement et opérationnelles vers la méthodologie DEVOPS
Compétences requises ou à acquérir
- Tu as développé des compétences polyvalentes dans les domaines de l'administration Linux et des connaissances sur les outils CI/CD couramment utilisés
- La démarche DevOps n'a plus de secret pour toi
- Tu maîtrises les sujets suivants : administration d'outils d'intégration continue comme Jenkins ou Gitlab-CI, Nexus/Artifactory, Sonarqube etc
- Des technologies autour des conteneurs, Docker, Kubernetes, Rancher, Openshift/okd
- Des providers Cloud, AWS, Azure, GCP
- Anglais TB niveau

jobs.title: Kokenut automekaanikko
jobs.description:
**Haemme Herttoniemeen kokenutta automekaanikkoa**

Etsimme ennen kaikkea vahvaa käytännön ammattilaista, joka hallitsee itsenäisen vianhaun, diagnostiikan ja vaativammat korjaustyöt. Tehtävän sisältöä ja vastuuta voidaan rakentaa valittavan henkilön vahvuuksien mukaan.

Työssä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti eri automerkkien huolto- ja korjaustöitä.

**Arvostamme** erityisesti kykyä ratkaista haastavampia vikoja itsenäisesti sekä varmaa otetta sähkö-, diagnostiikka-ja mekaanisiin korjauksiin.

**Palkkaus** on kilpailukykyinen ja aidosti neuvoteltavissa osaamisen, kokemuksen ja vastuun perusteella. Emme etsi halvinta tekijää vaan oikeaa ammattilaista.

**Toivomme sinulta:**

- vahvaa kokemusta automekaanikon työstä

- itsenäistä työotetta

- osaamista vianhaussa ja diagnostiikassa

- kykyä hoitaa vaativampiakin korjauksia alusta loppuun

- huolellista ja ammattimaista työnjälkeä

- Suomen kielen riittävää osaamista työskentelyyn ja kommunikointiin


**Tarjoamme:**

- vakituisen työn toimivassa autokorjaamossa Herttoniemessä

- monipuolisen työnkuvan

- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan tehtävänkuvaan ja vastuuseen

- kilpailukykyisen ja joustavasti neuvoteltavan palkkauksen

- mahdollisuuden ottaa halutessaan enemmän teknistä vastuuta korjaamon toiminnasta


**Myös yrittäjä- tai toiminimipohjaisesta yhteistyöstä** voidaan keskustella, jos se sopii sinulle paremmin kuin tavallinen työsuhde.

Jos olet kokenut asentaja ja etsit paikkaa, jossa osaamistasi arvostetaan ja jossa tehtävä voidaan rakentaa myös omien vahvuuksiesi ympärille, ota yhteyttä matalalla kynnyksellä.

  • Overvåge hjemmesidens tilgængelighed og funktionalitet samt rapportere fejl og problemer.

  • Deltage i test af nye produkter og tjenester.

  • Medvirke til at promovere nye produkter og kampagner.

  • Har fremragende skriftlige danskkundskaber og gode engelskkundskaber.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og motiveret for at nå interne mål.

  • Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljer.

  • Har erfaring med digitale arbejdsopgaver – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Gode muligheder for udvikling og ansvar

  • Danske kollegaer med et danske chefer

  • Sociale arrangementer

  • Hjælp med praktiske ting ved flytning til Malta

Stillingen er på fuld tid og omfatter vagter alle ugens syv dage, fordelt på fem ugentlige vagter inden for tidsrummet kl. 08.00–21.00.

jobs.title: Senior Shopify Developer & Platformansvarlig
jobs.description:
Vil du tage teknisk ansvar for vores Shopify-platforme og samtidig selv være hands-on i udviklingen?

Så skal du læse med her!

Vi søger en erfaren Shopify Plus udvikler til rollen som Senior Shopify Developer & Platformansvarlig, hvor du både bliver hands-on i koden og får et centralt teknisk ansvar. Du kommer til at løse komplekse problemer, bygge solide og skalerbare løsninger og få stor indflydelse på, hvordan vi videreudvikler vores e-commerce-platforme, tekniske standarder og løsninger på tværs af vores forretning.

Om GrejFreak.dk

GrejFreak.dk er Danmarks førende onlineforhandler af outdoor-, jagt- og militærudstyr. Vi leverer grej til både friluftsfolk, professionelle og helt almindelige danskere, der sætter pris på godt udstyr. Salget sker primært gennem GrejFreak.dk, men vi driver også andre webshops i Danmark og på internationale markeder.

Vi er en ambitiøs vækstvirksomhed med fokus på innovation, samarbejde og høj faglighed. Her er der plads til gode idéer, og vi lægger vægt på, at de hurtigt kan omsættes til handling.

Vores e-commerce-forretning er i vækst, og vi har mange spændende digitale initiativer foran os. Derfor ønsker vi at styrke vores interne tekniske kompetencer med en erfaren Shopify-specialist.

Dine ansvarsområder:

  • Bidrage til den tekniske opbygning af nye shops, markeder og digitale koncepter, herunder GrejFreak.dk, GearFreak.de, ReadyBox.dk samt nye webshops til vores private label brands.

  • Arbejde med integrationer mellem Shopify og øvrige forretnings- og marketingplatforme.

  • Sikre en struktureret udviklingsproces med versionsstyring, test, kvalitetssikring og dokumentation.

  • Udvikle interne værktøjer, automatiseringer og AI-understøttede løsninger, der kan effektivisere arbejdsgange og gøre hverdagen lettere for kolleger på tværs af virksomheden.

  • Fejlfinde og optimere eksisterende løsninger.

  • Vurdere tekniske løsningsmuligheder og rådgive om, hvornår noget bør udvikles, løses med standardfunktionalitet eller via tredjepartsløsninger.

  • Samarbejde med og kvalitetssikre leverancer fra eksterne udviklingspartnere.

  • Bidrage til fælles tekniske standarder og en robust, vedligeholdelsesvenlig platform.

jobs.title: Independent B2B Sales Partner – 3D Visualization, Product Configurators and VR
jobs.description:
I am Soyhan Yazgan, a software developer based in Orimattila, Finland. I have six years of software-consulting experience, including 4.5 years working on an Unreal Engine–based digital instrument-cluster project for Ford Motor Company.

I hold a bachelors degree in Software Engineering from Metropolia University of Applied Sciences and a masters degree in Game Business Management from Kajaani University of Applied Sciences. My core tools include Unreal Engine, 3ds Max, Corona Renderer and V-Ray.

I am now establishing an independent 3D/VR development studio and looking for a B2B sales partner whose commercial and relationship-building skills complement my technical expertise.

**What we would initially sell**

- Pre-rendered and real-time 3D visualization for architecture, machinery, furniture and vehicles, including still images, animations, interactive walkthroughs, and imagery for websites and print catalogs

- Interactive configurators for vehicles, kitchens, furniture systems, industrial equipment and other modular products

- VR or desktop-based product demonstrations, technical training applications and simulations


Potential customers include industrial manufacturers, training providers, construction and real estate companies, and marketing or design agencies that need a reliable white-label technical partner.

Typical projects run from several weeks to several months, with budgets of approximately €5,000–€30,000 excluding VAT, depending on scope. Engagements may begin as paid pilot projects, develop into recurring production work, or be delivered as larger phased projects.

**Your role**

- Identify and approach suitable B2B prospects

- Reach the appropriate decision-makers and qualify opportunities

- Arrange and lead introductory sales conversations

- Join discovery, proposal and negotiation meetings

- Help position the solution around the customers business problem

- Attend relevant trade fairs or customer meetings when mutually agreed


I will handle technical discovery, demonstrations, estimates, project scoping and delivery. We will agree on pricing boundaries together, and no proposal will be submitted without mutual approval.

**Commercial arrangement**

This is initially a flexible, non-exclusive independent partnership; not salaried employment. There is currently no guaranteed retainer or minimum number of hours.

Proposed commission model:

- 20% of collected project revenue, excluding VAT and agreed third-party expenses, for clients you source and actively help close


Commission would be paid proportionally as customer payments are received. Lead ownership, existing contacts, repeat projects, cancellations and post-termination commissions would be defined in a written agreement before outreach begins.

The arrangement is particularly suitable for an independent sales professional or agency that already serves relevant B2B customers and wants to add 3D, Unreal Engine or VR services to its offering.

**You may be a good fit if you have**

- Experience selling custom B2B services or technology projects

- Professional Finnish and English communication skills

- Strong prospecting, relationship-building and negotiation skills

- Contacts in manufacturing, training, construction, real estate or marketing

- The ability to work independently and represent technical services professionally


A particular degree is not required. Relevant results, relationships and business judgement are more important.

**Interested?**

Please send me:

- A short introduction

- Your LinkedIn profile

- The sectors in which you have experience or contacts

- An example of a B2B service or project you have helped sell


Email: soyhan15@gmail.com

I would be happy to arrange an introductory meeting to discuss the offering, target customers and cooperation model.

Soyhan Yazgan

Kallesoe Machinery A/S er en moderne, innovativ og højteknologisk virksomhed med base i Lem ved Ringkøbing. Vi udvikler og producerer avancerede systemløsninger til den bæredygtige byggeindustri i træ – og bidrager aktivt til en grønnere og mere ressourceeffektiv byggebranche globalt. jobs.title: Chef for the Winter Season – Family Hotel in Enontekiö, Finnish Lapland
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and skilled chef for a full-time seasonal position from late November until early April. The role involves working independently, and the working hours can be agreed upon in more detail.

We expect you to be reliable, proactive, efficient, cheerful, and physically fit. The salary will be determined in accordance with the Finnish hospitality industrys collective agreement (MaRa).

We hope you have:

- A valid Hygiene Passport and Alcohol Serving Passport

- Good Finnish language skills; English is considered an advantage

- The ability to independently prepare breakfast, lunch, and dinner

- The ability to maintain kitchen cleanliness and handle other daily kitchen duties

- Experience independently managing buffet service

- Professional references


The position begins in late November and continues until early April. The exact starting and ending dates, as well as working hours, can be agreed upon.

The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found. If you are moving to Enontekiö from elsewhere, we can assist you in finding accommodation.

Come and work in the spectacular surroundings of Käsivarsi, Finnish Lapland, for the winter season!

jobs.title: Course Writer and Editor UX UI and AI
jobs.description:
You're the one people trust with the words, whether you're writing them or fixing them. You noticed thatÂ you loved it, and that you were unusually good at it. You turn rough, complex ideas into words people understand.

Now you get the opportunity to work with some of the most respected designers alive, and help share their knowledge with hundreds of thousands of learners around the world.

A great hook pulls your readers in, makes them see themselves in the topic, and shows them why it matters in their lives. That's your craft. Abstract ideas don't stay abstract for long, because you find the example that makes an idea concrete. You're structured and systematic, yet creative, and you'll rewrite a sentence six times until it says exactly what you mean.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

If you're also curious about how great design and the responsible use of AI improve people's lives, read on. As one of our Course Writers and Editors, you'll shape how our courses and Master Classes read and flow.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe.

Youâll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between word and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help usÂ take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Writers and Editors:Â lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.

Weâre a flexible team, and youâll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Writer and Editor, own how our courses and Master Classes read: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish. OurÂ Education DesignersÂ hand you the structure and the exercises, and they'll often hand you draft headings and hooks along with them. The final wording is yours. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, your Team Lead, the Education Designers, and the Course Directors, and you'll have a real say in what we make. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team.Â You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders toÂ create educational content for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with skills inÂ timeless, human-centered design and AI.

  • Make an impact as you decide how every course sounds.Â The title people want to click, the first paragraph that hooks them, the on-screen words that make our learners remember and apply what our experts teach. Our Education Designers create the structure and draft the headings, hooks, and quizzes. You finalize the scripts, hooks, headings, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish, and you give proactive feedback on the structure.

  • You don't need a design background.Â Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. In your first year you'll learn it from the inside, working through it sentence by sentence with the people who teach it, until you know what a course participant needs.

  • Write for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields, and many are not reading in their first language. Often, you'll write for all of them at the same time. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge.

  • Be the voice of IxDF.Â Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours.Â Represent a global movement dedicated to design education, and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one.

  • Set and raise the standard for our assessments, so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests. Our Education Designers decide what a question has to test. You write the wording that does both.

  • Balance the big picture with the smaller details.Â Expect to focus on one large course creation project per month, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published. You'll also write and edit articles, course descriptions, and supporting material, and help our Growth team and our two founders get the voice right in campaigns and social copy.

  • Turn expert material into lessons.Â Once you've built an understanding of design, you'll take a one-hour Master Class transcript and the learning goals for what the lesson must teach, then turn the strongest sections into a finished lesson. We produce 3 Master Classes per month, so new expert material arrives continuously.

  • Our coursesÂ combine written and video lessons.Â You'll work closely with the video team, givingÂ constructive feedbackÂ on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios learners produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Small, incremental edits are why our material surpasses even the very best in industry and academia.Â We're always learning, always improving, always raising the barÂ in everything we do.

  • Weâre committed toâ¯excellence, and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role isâ¯not for the average. Ahead of you is aâ¯highly rewarding and enriching journey.

  • Maintain and improve ourÂ crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • You won't do this alone.Â You'll work with our Education Designers, Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the material: you'll add what's missing, delete what's redundant, and suggest how to improve the structure. You'll be working with people who have anything from 4 to 40 years of design experience, ready to share their knowledge. We'll also help you upskill so you can grow a designer's eye alongside your editor's ear. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll developÂ personally and professionally.

  • We're proud to have assembled aÂ remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

Do You Share IxDF's Vision?

People don't just buy our courses; they invest in a better version of themselves and a career they truly love. That's why every course we create and every sentence we write must do more than just inform. It must reflect the high-quality research and hands-on skills we teach.

You'll educate, inspire, energize, and support. Whether you write a course article or give editorial feedback on a video, you'll help designers thrive in the age of AI.

About You

  • You have at least 4 years of professional writing or editing experience.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education, and you look for new ways to use it in your own work.

  • You're fluent in written and spoken English, your grammar is exact, and you understand the power of tone, brevity, and microcopy.

  • You takeÂ full ownershipÂ of your work and see it through. You move comfortably across ad hoc projects of varying complexity, and you stay consistent when the work turns repetitive.

  • YouÂ value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace.

jobs.title: Genopslag: Pædagog eller social-/sundhedsfaglig medarbejder søges til Snåstrup Vestergård
jobs.description:
Er du vores nye kollega?
Er du pædagog – nyuddannet eller erfaren? 
Eller har du en relevant social- eller sundhedsfaglig uddannelse og den rette erfaring?
Har du samtidig lyst til et spændende og meningsfuldt arbejde med mennesker med udviklingshæmning, herunder borgere med dom?
Så er det måske lige dig, vi leder efter på Snåstrup Vestergård

Om Jobbet:
På Snåstrup Vestergaard – en del af Center for Specialpædagogik og Psykiatri (CSP) søger vi en socialpædagog eller pædagogisk assistent. 

Vi arbejder vi ud fra en grundlæggende tro på, at borgeren skal være ved roret i eget liv. Vores tilgang er recovery-orienteret rehabiliterende, og vi har et stærkt fokus på at understøtte borgernes håb, drømme og ønsker – både dem, der former hverdagen og dem, der rækker længere ud i livet. Det kræver en høj grad af faglighed, struktur og vedholdenhed, men også masser af nærvær, humor og varme i hverdagen.
Vi har pt plads til 20 borgere, som alle lever med et udviklingshandicap og har brug for denne særligt tilrettelagte pædagogiske indsats, er kriminalitetstruede eller idømte en foranstaltningsdom. Udviklingshandicappet er ofte kombineret med andre udfordringer som psykiatriske diagnoser og misbrugsproblematikker.

Din profil:
Som pædagog på Snåstrup bliver du en central del af et tværfagligt team med pædagoger, social- og sundhedsassistenter, ergoterapeut, sygeplejerske samt pædagogiske assistenter. Sammen med dine kollegaer får du ansvar for at tilrettelægge, gennemføre og evaluere indsatser med udgangspunkt i den enkelte borgers behov, ressourcer og ønsker for livet.

I praksis betyder det, at du:

  • Støtter borgerne i deres dagligdag, fx omkring måltider, personlig omsorg, struktur og aktiviteter.
  • Planlægger og deltager i aktiviteter i dag- og fritidslivet, fx musik, madlavning, gåture, samt ledsagelse til behandlingstilbud som fx rusmiddelcenteret. 
  • Dokumenterer og evaluerer pædagogiske indsatser i tæt samarbejde med kollegaer.
  • Arbejder metodisk med afsæt i KRAP (Kognitiv, Ressourcefokuseret og Anerkendende Pædagogik) og neuropædagogisk tilgang. Desuden er vi i gang med implementering af LA2u, som du vil blive introduceret til. En metode til at inddrage borgerens indefra-perspektiv, forebygge voldsomme episoder og styrke trivsel, særligt tilpasset borgere med udviklingshæmning.
  • Indgår i samarbejdet om at skabe struktur, ro og tryghed, også i situationer, der kan være uforudsigelige eller præget af udadreagerende adfærd.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller har anden relevant socialfaglig eller sundhedsfaglig uddannelse. 
  • Er nyuddannet og gerne vil have erfaring hos os eller kan have erfaring fra lignende område – gerne med borgere med udviklingshandicap og udfordrende adfærd - men det er ikke et krav.
  • Møder både borgere og kollegaer med respekt, ordentlighed og en anerkendende tilgang.
  • Kan bevare overblikket og handle konstruktivt i uforudsigelige situationer.
  • Trives i en hverdag, hvor opgaverne kan være mangeartede: fra praktiske gøremål til komplekse pædagogiske indsatser.
  • Har gyldigt kørekort og kan anvende IT til dokumentation.
  • Bidrager med stabilitet, engagement og et positivt sind - også når det går stærkt.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig:

Vi ønsker at skabe rammer, hvor både borgere og medarbejdere kan udvikle sig. Som ny pædagog på Snåstrup får du derfor:

  • Et grundigt introduktionsforløb med mentor og mulighed for introvagter efter behov.
  • Løbende faglig sparring, supervision og teammøder.
  • Mulighed for deltagelse i årlige temadage med fokus på faglig udvikling.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi tager arbejdsmiljøet alvorligt, og hvor der er plads til både faglige ambitioner, humor og fællesskab.

Kort sagt: Et job med faglige udfordringer, personlig udvikling og mulighed for at være en del af et sted, hvor indsatsen virkelig gør en forskel for andre mennesker.

Her kan du se lidt mere om Snåstrup: 

John D Band - SÆRTRANSPORT - official video 2021

Snåstrups Miljøteam maj 2024 - beboernes perspektiv

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer.
Stillingen er til enhver tid betinget af en tilfredsstillende offentlig straffeattest. Arbejdstiderne er dag og aftenvagter med et overtal af aftenvagter. Weekendarbejde hver anden weekend. 
Ugentligt timetal: Fuldtid.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse til: Afdelingsleder Djanik Gade Laursen på 23807568 eller Line Julie Holck på 41876746

Ansøgning
Ansøgningsfrist er: søndag d. 6/9
Samtalerne afholdes torsdag d. 10/9

Opstart 1. november eller efter aftale. 
Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning.

Stillinger i Aarhus Kommune søges elektronisk. Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Om os
Centret samler bo- og aktivitetstilbud til borgere med udviklingshæmning, herunder personer med behov for en specialiseret indsats som følge af aldring, psykiatri, hjerneskade, dom, rusmiddelproblematikker eller et omfattende behov for pleje og omsorg. Indsatsen i centeret har fokus på at styrke borgernes forbundethed gennem relationer, almene fællesskaber og deltagelse i samfundslivet. Der arbejdes med at fremme borgerens tro på egne evner og bidrage til en selvforståelse der rækker udover funktionsnedsættelsen. Gennem hverdags- og arbejdsaktiviteter styrkes borgernes indflydelse på eget liv og evne til at mestre det. Centret har samlet fokus på at sikre en sammenhængende helhedsindsats på tværs af døgnet med udgangspunkt i den enkelte borgers ressourcer, behov og muligheder.
  
Om Sociale Forhold og BeskæftigelseVi ved, at det gode liv går gennem uddannelse, job og selvforsørgelse for langt de fleste – og meningsfulde fællesskaber for alle. Derfor er vi mere end 7000 mennesker, der går på arbejde hver dag for aarhusianere med et handicap, et integrationsbehov, dem, der lever socialt udsatte liv og dem, der har brug for at finde vej til det næste job. Vi arbejder med alt det, der er svært, men også med det vigtigste, der findes: aarhusianernes kernevelfærd. Vi er årligt i kontakt med omkring 100.000 aarhusianere, der får vores støtte til et liv med håb og handlekraft.

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.    

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

jobs.title: Barcelona Winbacksäljare
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av rörliga elavtal till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

Primary location:
PORI

Ravintolatyöntekijäksi kokouspalvelun tehtäviin Porin Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunaan

Tule vastaamaan asiakkaidemme sujuvista ja viimeistellyistä tilaus- ja kokoustapahtumista! Haemme Porin Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunan kokous- ja tilausravintolaan kahta ravintolatyöntekijää työskentelemään kokouspalvelun tehtävissä. Tehtävät ovat osa-aikaisia, 20 h/vko ja määräaikaisia vuoden 2026 loppuun, aloitus on joustavasti sovittavissa. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme niin arkena kuin myös juhlapyhinä, joten työvuorot voivat sijoittua koko viikon akselille ja kyseessä on vaihteleva vuorotyö.

Tule kanssamme tekemään ihan tavallisia töitä ja luomaan elämyksiä, jotka jäävät asiakkaidemme mieleen!

Työ on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu kokouspalveluiden toteuttaminen aina kokoustilojen valmistelusta ja asiakkaiden toiveiden huomioimisesta kahvitarjoiluiden esillelaittoon ja lounastarjoiluun. Lisäksi pääset osallistumaan erilaisten tilaisuuksien ja illallisten järjestämiseen kokous- ja tilausravintolassamme. Tarjoilut toteutetaan tilanteen mukaan buffet- tai pöytiintarjoiluna, ja kokonaisuuksiin kuuluu myös juomatarjoilu. Asiakastilaisuudet vaihtelevat pienistä ja tunnelmallisista kokouksista suuriin messuihin, juhliin ja jopa häihin, joten yksikään työpäivä ei ole samanlainen.

Meille kaikkein tärkeintä on aito huomaavaisuus ja asiakkaidemme odotusten ylittäminen. Odotamme sinulta tinkimätöntä palveluasennetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä halua työskennellä tiiminä kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita ja onnistumisia. Haluat ottaa vastuuta onnistuneista asiakaskohtaamisista ja varmistaa vieraidemme viihtyvyyden kokous toisensa jälkeen. Aiempi kokemus ravintola-alalta tai asiakaspalvelusta katsotaan eduksi. Tehtävässä edellytetään täysi-ikäisyyttä.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen tehtävän upeassa hotelliympäristössä, jossa pääset luomaan mieleenpainuvia kokemuksia asiakkaillemme. Tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen sekä ympäristön, jossa laatu, vieraanvaraisuus ja yhdessä onnistuminen ovat keskiössä.

jobs.title: Fitnessinstruktør til Loop Kolding
jobs.description:
Vi er et center i udvikling og søger derfor nye medarbejdere – og meget gerne en studerende, fleksjobber, efterlønner eller lign. Der er tale om en timelønnet stilling fra 4 til 12 timer ugentligt og flere ved weekend, ferie mm. 

Beskrivelse af jobbet og forventninger:

En stor del af jobbet vil være kontakt med vores medlemmer, instruere brugerne af vores maskiner og koncept, samt rengøring.

Efter grundig kort oplæring af vores koncept, skal du udføre prøve- og instruktørtimer til nye og nuværende medlemmer ved guidning og fysisk instruktion.

Du skal på brugerniveau kunne benytte vores eget IT-system til at oprette nye medlemmer, oprette aftaler mm. Du skal kunne tale og skrive dansk, da du både er i personlig kontakt, telefonisk kontakt og skrivende kontakt med medlemmer og kollegaer.

Du skal være smilende, serviceminded og empatisk og du skal kunne kommunikere med kunder i alle aldre

Du skal fysisk kunne deltage i rengøringsopgaver i centret, da vi sætter stor pris på at vores center altid er pænt og rent, men opgaverne er tilpasset og opdelt.

Du skal kunne træne i vores udstyr og hvis man har lyst, er der mulighed for at kunne undervise i holdtræning.

Du skal selvstændigt kunne arbejde på vagter af 4-6 timers varighed ad gangen hvor man aktivt skal være i centret i hele vagten, gående og stående med afveksling. Vagterne kan ligge i både formiddags- og eftermiddagstimerne, samt i weekender.

Der vil til tider være arrangementer, events og outgoing opgaver.

Vi forventer at du er god til at skabe kontakt til andre mennesker, er ansvarsbevidst, selvkørende, smilende og udadvendt. At du kan få alle vores medlemmer til at føle sig velkommen, hver gang de kommer og træner.

Hvad kan du forvente af os:

I LOOP er vi kendt for vores gode service og nærvær og vores arrangement sammen med vores medlemmer, så du vil blive en del af et godt team, der hjælper hinanden og du vil få en arbejdsplads med skønne sociale medlemmer omkring dig.

Hos os kan du forvente et arbejde med frihed under ansvar, du vil blive grundigt oplært i den daglige drift, og der vil løbende være kurser der oplære dig i korrekt brug af maskinerne mm.

Lyder det som jobbet for dig, så send en mail til Tanja på tjm@loopfitness.dk

Der vil løbende blive indkaldt til samtaler, med opstart snarest muligt.

jobs.title: Area Chief Engineer, Oslo
jobs.description:
Company Description

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.

People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time.

Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

Job Description

We are currently seeking an Area Chief Engineer to join our vibrant team. At RHG, we are in search of individuals who go beyond the resume – those with character, skills, talents, and a passion for creating memorable experiences. We value mindset as pivotal: anticipating guest needs, supporting your department, and consistently delivering memorable experiences.

The Area Chief Engineer role offers the opportunity to shape and lead the engineering strategy across our hotels in the Oslo area. The role is responsible for leading and overseeing the engineering, security and technical operations.

In addition to being a hands-on position, this role focuses on leadership, project management, asset optimisation and supporting our hotel engineering teams to deliver operational excellence.

Working across our Oslo portfolio, you will oversee engineering operations, major maintenance projects, CapEx investments, technical compliance and security coordination while acting as a trusted advisor to hotel leadership, property owners and external partners.

If you are an organised engineering leader who enjoys bringing structure, driving improvements and leading complex technical projects, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and support the Chief Engineers across the Oslo area hotel portfolio, creating consistency, structure and best practice.
  • Oversee engineering operations across our hotels in the Oslo area, ensuring maintenance, safety and technical standards are delivered to the highest level.
  • Plan, manage and oversee major refurbishment, renovation and technical installation projects from budgeting through execution.
  • Manage CapEx projects, long-term investment plans and engineering budgets, ensuring cost-effective delivery and value for owners.
  • Support hotel engineering teams with procurement, investment applications, project planning and technical administration.
  • Act as the technical liaison between Radisson Hotel Group, property owners, contractors and external suppliers.
  • Ensure effective preventive maintenance programmes are planned, monitored and continuously improved.
  • Coordinate engineering strategies that maximise asset performance, minimise downtime and improve operational efficiency.
  • Oversee engineering-related sustainability initiatives, including energy-saving projects and optimisation of building systems.
  • Work closely with the dedicated security team to ensure fire safety, emergency procedures, compliance inspections and technical safety programmes are effectively coordinated across all properties.
  • Ensure all engineering activities comply with legislation, health & safety requirements, fire regulations and Radisson Hotel Group standards.
  • Build strong relationships with General Managers and hotel leadership teams, providing expert technical guidance and support.
Qualifications

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent leadership and organisational skills.

You will ideally have:

  • An engineering qualification or degree, preferably within mechanical, electrical, building services or technical installations.
  • Extensive experience leading engineering, maintenance or technical operations across multiple sites or complex properties.
  • Experience managing large technical projects, renovations, CapEx investments and contractor relationships.
  • Strong understanding of property maintenance, building systems and technical installations.
  • Excellent financial and commercial awareness, including budgeting and investment planning.
  • Proven leadership experience with the ability to coach, influence and develop teams.
  • Outstanding planning and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work with hotel leaders, owners, contractors and suppliers.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with excellent problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
  • Fluency in Norwegian and English, both written and spoken.
Additional Information

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?

Live the Magic of Hospitality - Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

Build a Great Career - No matter your background or experience, we invest in your growth, learning, and career development—helping you reach your full potential.

Experience the Team Spirit - Join a workplace that’s inclusive, fun, and meaningful. We celebrate diversity, support one another, and foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives.

Lead with Your Ambition - Your ideas, passion, and drive matter! We empower you to make a difference - in hospitality, your community and beyond.

Enjoy Global & Local Perks - No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! If you’re ready to bring your talent, energy, and passion, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.

jobs.title: Keikkatekijää keittiöön Kristiinankaupunkiin
jobs.description:
Etsimme Kristiinankaupungille keikkatekijöitä keittiön eri tehtäviin. Olipa taustasi sitten suurtalouskokki tai astiahuoltaja, niin etsimme eri pituisiin sijaisuuksiin reippaita ja motivoituneita tekijöitä.

Kristiinankaupungin alueella sekä lähikunnissa on kouluja sekä päiväkoteja, joiden keittiöihin tarvitaan silloin tällöin sijaisia. Onko sinulla tarvetta keikkatyölle tai haluatko saada "jalkaa oven väliin"? Tässä on sinulle oiva mahdollisuus päästä tutustumaan eri toimipisteiden tehtäviin.

Etsimme osaavia ja koulutuksen omaavia kokkeja sekä keittiöapulaisia avustaviin tehtäviin.
- Kokin tehtävään vaadimme koulutuksen tai vähintään työkokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä sekä kielitaitoa (suomi tai ruotsi).
- Keittiöapulaiseksi etsimme reippaita, motivoituneita tekijöitä, jotka omaa kokemusta keittiö ympäristön eri töistä. Kielitaitona mieluiten suomi tai ruotsi, mutta myös hyvä englanti riittää.
Mitä me etsimme:
- Tarvetta on erityisesti keikka-tekijöille, joten arvostamme mahdollisuutta vastaanottaa työvuoroja lyhyelläkin varoitusajalla. Toki samoja sijaisia kysytään aina ensisijaisesti myös pidempiin sijaisuuksiin.
- Työvuorot ovat aina arkisin 7-17 välisenä aikana.
- Oman auton käyttöä, sillä sijaisuuksia voi tulla myös lähiseudulta
- Hygieniapassin tulee olla voimassa

Noudatamme työssä KVTES palkkataulukkoa:
Keittäjän (tasopalkka 4RUO50B1) tuntipalkka 14,91€
Keittäjän (tasopalkka 4RUO50A1) tuntipalkka 13,64€
Keittiöapulaisen tuntipalkka (tasopalkka 4RUO70A1) 13,02€

På Svenska:
Vi söker till Kristinestad inhoppare till olika köksuppgifter. Oavsett om du har bakgrund som storkock eller diskare söker vi pigga och motiverade personer för vikariat av olika längd.
I Kristinestads område samt i närliggande kommuner finns skolor och daghem vars kök periodvis är i behov av vikarier. Har du behov av inhopp eller vill du få in en fot genom dörren? Här har du en utmärkt möjlighet att bekanta dig med arbetsuppgifter vid olika enheter.

Vi söker yrkeskunniga och utbildade kockar samt köksbiträden för assisterande uppgifter.
- För kockuppgifter kräver vi utbildning eller minst arbetserfarenhet från motsvarande uppgifter samt språkkunskaper (finska eller svenska).
- Som köksbiträde söker vi pigga och motiverade personer, som har erfarenhet av olika arbetsuppgifter i köksmiljö. Språkkunskaper i första hand finska eller svenska, men även god engelska räcker.

Vad vi söker:
- Behovet gäller i synnerhet inhoppare, så vi uppskattar möjlighet att ta emot arbetspass även med kort varsel. Samma vikarier tillfrågas i första hand också för längre vikariat.
- Arbetspassen är alltid vardagar mellan kl. 7–17.
- Tillgång till egen bil, eftersom vikariat även kan förekomma i närområdet.
- Giltigt hygienpass krävs.
Vi erbjuder en bra introduktion!

- Kock (grundlön 4RUO50B1): timlön 14,91 €
- Kock (grundlön 4RUO50A1): timlön 13,64 €
- Köksbiträde (grundlön 4RUO70A1): timlön 13,02 €

jobs.title: Erfaren tjener søges til Michelin-anbefalede Restaurant Abigail i indre by
jobs.description:
Erfaren tjener søges til Michelin-anbefalede Restaurant Abigail i indre by - deltid

Brænder du for klassisk værtskab, stor faglighed og den personlige gæsteoplevelse? Har du øje for detaljen, arbejder struktureret – og elsker du at levere service på højeste niveau? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Restaurant Abigail leverer gastronomi på absolut højeste niveau. Her kan du opleve en eksklusiv 11-retters tastingmenu, hvor hver servering er nøje komponeret med fokus på smag, æstetik og kvalitet. Dertil byder restauranten på et imponerende stort og bredt vinkort med udsøgte vine fra hele verden – nøje udvalgt til at fuldende din oplevelse.

Til vores dedikerede team søger vi nu en erfaren tjener med vinkendskab, der vil være med til at løfte vores gæsteoplevelser endnu højere.

Om stillingen

  • Deltid med fleksibel vagtplan

  • Start: Efter aftale – vi venter gerne på den rette

  • Arbejdssted: København

  • Løn: Konkurrencedygtig og baseret på erfaring og kvalifikationer

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Har minimum 1 års erfaring som tjener – gerne fra gastronomisk niveau

  • Er fagligt stærk, detaljeorienteret og vant til at arbejde struktureret

  • Brænder for vin og mad i samspil

  • Trives i et travlt miljø med høje standarder og naturlig gæstekontakt

  • Er en god kollega og teamplayer med positiv energi og ansvarsfølelse

Vi tilbyder:

  • En vigtig rolle i et lille, dedikeret team med stærkt sammenhold

  • Mulighed for videreudvikling, f.eks. som ansvarlig på gulvet, med menu- og vinkort-præsentationer og eventuelt ansvar for oplæring af nye kollegaer

  • En flad organisation med respekt og plads til den enkelte

  • En arbejdsplads hvor arbejdsglæde og faglighed går hånd i hånd

  • Gode personalegoder – bl.a. fordelagtige priser på vores restauranter

Hvorfor vælge os?

Hos Abigail prioriterer vi kvalitet – både i forhold til vores produkt og i vores arbejdsmiljø. Vi tror på, at den bedste service kommer fra et sted med overskud og arbejdsglæde. Du bliver en del af en restaurant, hvor både gæster og medarbejdere føler sig hjemme, og hvor den gode stemning mærkes fra første møde.

Er du klar til næste skridt i din tjenerkarriere – i et miljø med hjerte, faglighed og ambitioner?

jobs.description:
Meille autonasentajaksi?

Haemme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen ammattitaitoista ja ahkeraa autonasentajaa, jolla on hyvä työasenne. Pystyt huoltamaan ja korjaamaan itsenäisesti henkilö- ja pakettiautoja. Sinulta onnistuu vianhaku, diagnosointi sekä haastavammatkin huolto- ja korjaustyöt.

Mitä toivomme hakijalta?

- autoalan koulutusta ja vähintään 1 vuoden työkokemusta alalta
- omatoimisuutta, huolellisuutta sekä tehokasta otetta työntekoon
- hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja joustavuutta
- Autofutur-ohjelmiston käyttökokemus on eduksi

- mahdollisuuden halutessasi korjata ja fiksata omia autojasi tiloissamme viikonloppuisin

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian!

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi, jossa kerrot itsestäsi sekä aiemmasta työkokemuksestasi ja osaamisestasi. Lähetäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa toimitusjohtaja Eero Eloranta p. 045 872 3934, sähköposti: eero.eloranta@tampereenautolasipalvelu.fi.

Keitä me olemme?

Olemme paikallinen perheyritys. Meille on tärkeintä työntekijöidemme hyvä viihtyvyys sekä erinomainen asiakaspalvelu laadukkaan työnjäljen lisäksi. Kuulumme valtakunnallisiin Autofit ja First Stop -ketjuihin, jotka takaavat mahdollisuudet esim. lisäkoulutuksiin työntekijöiden oman kiinnostuksen mukaan. Työllistämme tällä hetkellä neljä autonasentajaa, kaksi työnjohtajaa ja kaksi tuulilasiasentajaa. Yrityksen virallinen nimi on Tampereen Autolasipalvelu Oy, joka on toiminut jo vuodesta 1993 alkaen. Yrittäjinä ovat toimineet vuodesta 2011 alkaen ylöjärveläiset Eero ja Katri Eloranta.

jobs.title: Lead Electrical Engineer, Industry
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced electrical professional ready to combine deep engineering expertise with technical leadership? Were looking for you!

You'll find a summary of the role in Finnish at the end of the job advertisement.

Your role and the team

Join us at Elomatic as we strengthen our Electrical, Instrumentation, and Automation Engineering team! Our offices are in Espoo, Jyväskylä, Oulu, Tampere and Turku — just tell us your preferred location in your application!

As a Lead Electrical Engineer, you will play an active role in multidisciplinary projects and, together with your team, be responsible for electrical engineering throughout all project phases, from pre-engineering to implementation. Your key responsibilities will include technical specifications, dimensioning and calculations, engineering documentation, and cost estimation for industrial power distribution and process electrical systems.

You will evaluate alternative technical solutions and related risks while ensuring that project deliveries meet our clients' technical, operational, and lifecycle objectives. In addition, you will ensure that all solutions comply with applicable standards and regulatory requirements.

As part of the project team, you will work closely with clients, suppliers, contractors, and experts from other engineering disciplines throughout the entire project lifecycle. Depending on your experience and interests, your responsibilities may also include concept engineering, procurement support, site supervision, and commissioning activities.

You will be part of our Industry Business Unit, where we deliver a wide range of industrial investment projects for clients ranging from startups and growth companies to established industrial organizations across both the private and public sectors. Our projects include energy transition investments such as electric boilers, heat pumps, green hydrogen and ammonia facilities, wind power, and energy storage systems. In addition, we work on projects within traditional industries, including power generation, chemical, food and beverage, pharmaceutical, pulp, and paper sectors.

What helps you succeed in this role

- A relevant technical education, e.g. bachelor or masters in electrical engineering
- Strong experience in electrical engineering and preferably also in consulting business
- Knowledge in medium and low voltage systems in industrial environments and knowledge in high voltage is a plus but not a requirement
- Experience in different processes e.g. industry, energy and power, chemical, food

- Familiarity with database-based design tools
- Strong communication skills – fluent Finnish and good English, both spoken and written
- A proactive, solution-oriented mindset
- Team spirit, collaboration, and knowledge sharing

What we promise you

Interesting and challenging projects with a team that supports each other. Modern tools and technologies. Hybrid working flexibility to balance work and free time. Training and mentoring to help you grow, and our warm EloWe culture built on respect, equality, kindness, and support.

Learn more about our Industry projects here: [Industry BU](https://www.elomatic.com/industry/)
Get to know your future colleagues: [Meet Us! videos](https://www.youtube.com/@ElomaticOy/shorts)

Please share your thoughts regarding salary expectations in your application. Our compensation aligns with trade union recommendations and reflects your future role, capabilities and skills, working experience and specialization. Additionally, we offer versatile employee benefits, including comprehensive insurance and support for sports and cultural activities.

We succeed together, we have passion to improve, we are trustworthy

If you share our values and are ready for this exciting opportunity, apply with your CV and cover letter in English or Finnish by September 20th at the latest. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and working styles, different perspectives make us stronger. We review applications continuously and are ready to start interviews during the application period.

For more information, please contact

Senior Manager Karl-Gustav Pihl, tel. +358 401734396, karl-gustav.pihl@elomatic.com

And remember to follow us on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/elomaticoy/) and [LinkedIn!](https://www.linkedin.com/company/elomatic/)

jobs.title: Procurement Analytics Manager | Mehiläinen | Bucharest or Helsinki
jobs.description:
Mehiläinen is Finland's largest private healthcare and social services group, operating across seven European countries. Group Procurement is in the middle of a deliberate shift, away from periodic reports that sit in an inbox until someone opens them and self-service dashboards, toward a live intelligence layer that flags what matters before anyone has to ask. We are looking for someone to help design that shift, not maintain what already exists.

The opportunity
This role reports to the Head of Procurement Excellence, with visibility that reaches the CPO and CFO from day one. You will work at group level across every category and country we operate in, which means real influence without the overhead of managing a team. If you have been looking for a role where impact is not measured by headcount, this one is built for that.

What you will build
Design and own the group's savings tracking methodology, working directly with FP&A so every number holds up under scrutiny
Architect a live view of spend, price, and supplier performance that replaces static reports and dashboards with insights and alerts separating signal from noise and people actually can act on
Decide what should trigger an escalation, not just document what already happened, by building the thresholds and exception logic that keep leadership informed without being asked
Shape how AI and automation change the way the function measures itself, from spend classification to compliance monitoring
Build the sustainability reporting Mehiläinen needs as ESG expectations grow, including CO2 data and supplier risk tracking
Take a real seat at the table in Mehiläinen's group procurement technology roadmap, from tool selection through implementation

Is this you?
This probably is not the right fit if you are looking for a brief and a template to fill in. It is the right fit if you would rather decide what gets measured and why, and you are comfortable being the person who makes that call and challenges the status quo.
You have spent enough years at the intersection of financial controlling, procurement, data, or analytics to have formed your own opinions about how it should be done, whether that came from a controller seat, a reporting role, or something less conventional
You have owned a data or reporting problem end to end at least once, from raw numbers to a decision someone else made because of your work
You are genuinely curious about where AI and automation are taking procurement and analytics, not as a buzzword but as something you want to build with
You can hold your own in a room with the CPO and CFO, translating complex data into something a non-technical leader can act on immediately
Professional proficiency in English

What we offer
You will join Group Procurement at the point where its data and reporting foundation is still being built, with a real mandate to shape it. Meaningful visibility with senior leadership from day one, a flexible and hybrid way of working, and a competitive package. Mehiläinen is Finland's largest private healthcare and social services provider, with a mission and a growth trajectory people want to be part of.
