Procurement Lead Buyer (m/f/d)

Job Description

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. If you are eager to learn, are interested in growing rapidly and strive to make an impact in a diverse environment, you're in the right place at the right time.

Learn more about Careers at KPMG Luxembourg

We are looking for a Lead Buyer (m/f/d) for our Procurement team

As a Lead Buyer reporting to the Procurement Manager, you will play a key role in supporting and developing the procurement function at KPMG Luxembourg. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and purchasing activities across your assigned procurement categories while working closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver value through strategic procurement initiatives.
In this role, you will contribute to the development of purchasing strategies, supplier optimization initiatives and cost-saving opportunities. You will also ensure compliance with procurement policies, maintain strong supplier relationships and support the continuous evolution of the procurement function.

What you will be working on

• Propose and develop purchasing strategies for assigned procurement categories.
• Analyze spend allocation, supplier portfolios and procurement opportunities.
• Develop short-, medium- and long-term action plans including spend optimization, contract renewal strategies, supplier rationalization and risk mitigation initiatives.
• Participate in defining savings targets and identifying opportunities for improvement.
• Identify, evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost and reliability.
• Lead sourcing activities including RFPs, RFQs and supplier negotiations.
• Manage purchase orders and monitor delivery performance.
• Build and maintain strong supplier relationships and monitor supplier performance.
• Ensure compliance with procurement policies, internal controls and regulatory requirements.
• Prepare procurement reports and contribute to cost control initiatives.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and provide guidance regarding procurement processes and procedures.

What we look for

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Logistics or a related field.
• Several years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, purchasing or supply chain management.
• Experience in supplier sourcing, contract negotiation and supplier relationship management.
• Good understanding of procurement processes, sourcing methodologies and procurement best practices.
• Ability to identify cost-saving opportunities and drive procurement efficiencies.
• Experience working with procurement systems and ERP tools (SAP, Oracle, Coupa or similar).
• Strong analytical and reporting skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills.
• Ability to build collaborative relationships and influence outcomes across the organization.
• Fluent English is required; French is considered an asset.

What you will get

We offer more than just a job. With our flexible work model, you can work, rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time off, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and well-being help to keep you refreshed and motivated.

We will accompany you on a journey of professional growth, offering an expansive spectrum of prospects to elevate your career in Luxembourg, an emerging financial center. Feel a sense of belonging by enjoying year-round celebrations and engaging events that bring us all together.

…You are the candidate we are looking for!

We are delighted to represent a well-known, well-established asset manager in their search for a Risk Analyst for a 6 months contract. Profile sought

• Bachelor's degree (or higher) in economics, finance, or a quantitative discipline
• 3-5 years experience in the fund industry in Luxembourg, ideally in a risk management role
• Strong understanding of Luxembourg and EU regulatory frameworks (UCITS, AIFM)
• Solid knowledge of risk management concepts, asset management, and financial markets
• Experience with valuation methodologies and risk models (e.g. DCF, multiples, VaR, stress testing)
• Understanding of private/alternative asset classes (Real Estate, Private Equity, Private Credit)
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret and communicate complex topics clearly
• Ability to engage constructively with team and stakeholders and provide independent challenge
• Proficiency in English (written and spoken); French is an advantage
• Familiarity with data and risk systems/tools (e.g. Power BI, eFront, Aladdin)
• Professional certifications (CFA, FRM, CAIA) are an advantage

jobs.title: Senior Fraud Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.

As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your next challenge:

• Fraud Prevention & Detection:

• Develop and implement comprehensive fraud prevention strategies, policies, and procedures in line with regulatory requirements and business needs.
• Risk Assessment: Evaluate and analyze risks associated with fraud to develop strategies for prevention and mitigation.
• Monitor continuously transactions and activities to identify potential fraudulent behavior, suspicious activity, utilizing advanced analytics and fraud detection tools.

• Investigation & Analysis:

• Lead investigations into suspected fraudulent activities, coordinating with internal teams and external authorities as necessary.
• Conducting thorough investigations into suspected fraud cases, gathering evidence, and documenting findings.
• Analyze patterns and trends in fraud cases to prepare reports and recommend improvements to fraud prevention strategies.
• Collaboration & Communication:
• Work closely with compliance, legal, and operational teams to ensure alignment on fraud risk management practices, to address fraud cases and improve security measures.
• Communicate findings, trends, and recommendations to senior management and relevant stakeholders/ authorities in a clear and concise manner.

• Training & Awareness:

• Develop and conduct training sessions for staff on fraud prevention techniques and policies to foster a culture of awareness and vigilance.
• Educate staff and clients about fraud prevention techniques and the importance of reporting suspicious activities.
• Create engaging training materials that effectively convey complex fraud-related information.
• Regulatory Compliance:
• Stay updated on relevant regulations and industry best practices related to fraud prevention, ensuring that the organization remains compliant.
• Keep abreast of current fraud trends and techniques to adapt prevention strategies accordingly.  
• Prepare and maintain accurate records of fraud cases, investigations, and preventive measures.

Your skills:

• Education:

• Master's degree in finance, business administration, criminal justice, or a related field. A master's degree or professional certifications (e.g., Certified Fraud Examiner - CFE) is preferred.

• Experience:

• Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in fraud prevention, investigations, or related areas within the banking or financial services sector.
• Proven track record of successfully managing fraud investigations and implementing effective fraud prevention strategies.

• Skills:

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to analyze complex data and identify patterns.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
• You are fluent in French and English.
• Demonstrated leadership abilities, with a proactive approach to managing teams and projects.
• Lives the 80/20 principle and gets things done
• Can see the big picture and can think long-term
• Caring: Empathetic and open-minded, fostering a supportive environment for team members and stakeholders.
• Leading: Ability to lead by example and inspire others through commitment to excellence in fraud prevention.
• Engaging: Passionate about fraud prevention and dedicated to engaging with all levels of the organization.
• Accessible: Approachable and credible, ensuring stakeholders feel comfortable discussing concerns related to fraud.
• Reliable: Committed to following through on tasks, ensuring thorough documentation and timely reporting of fraud cases.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

Information Security Officer

About Luxtrust

We are a multicultural and forward-thinking qualiﬁed Trust Services Provider based in Capellen, Luxembourg, with over 110 professionals and actively expanding our business internationally. We provide state-of-the-art on on-boarding, digital identities, strong authentication and security services, and qualiﬁed electronic signatures, all bundled into integrated digital documents & identity management solutions.

As a Trusted Partner, we prioritize building long-lasting relationships with our international clients and stakeholders, based on trust and integrity. We strive to be a Committed Partner, dedicating ourselves to delivering exceptional performance and showing steadfast commitment to make a positive impact. As a Visionary Scout, we are constantly seeking out new opportunities for growth and innovation, always staying ahead of the curve in our industry.

Join us in our mission to drive innovation and co-create a better future!

We are currently looking for a motivated and driven Information Security Officer.

Summary

This role contributes to improve IT security controls effectiveness, increase ISMS process maturity and keep IT risks exposure under accepted level by assisting the Chief Information Security Officer in its missions.

Missions of the role

• Security Operation activities such as vulnerability management; threats monitoring; threat prevention (phishing tentative, SIEM alerts) and log review. Improve threat detection capabilities by reviewing SIEM use cases on a regular basis in closed collaboration with our SOC partner.
• The security recurring controls annual plan such as access right reviews, suppliers due diligence, Supplier Review Meetings, hardening guide and CIS conformity audits of IT.
• Involved in penetration-testing campaign on corporate environment. Defines pen-testing scope, prepare and coordinate pen-testers activities, review pen-testing results with IT department and manage recommendations action plan.
• LuxTrust security controls: contribute to annual supplier due diligence assessment, represent department in the Compliance and audit exercises and maintain our security controls documentation accordingly.
• Security incident: Involved in security Incident review, problem review and associated KPIs / KRIs reporting.
• Contribute to an ongoing, proactive risk assessment program for all new and existing systems in our corporate environment and ensure that effective controls to manage these risks are in place against the company's goals and business processes.
• Participate in Audit ISO27001 and any other audits applicable to LuxTrust entities.
• Manages security awareness annual program.
• Implements security improvements by assessing current situation; evaluating trends; anticipating requirements; evaluation security incidents.
•  Provide Information Security advisory to both IT and Business units by assisting Legal, Compliance and Sales teams in due diligence exercises, new process flow or use cases and any security questions. Lead supplier due diligence assessment for the security aspects.
•  Maintain and improve ISMS documentation based on knowledge of best practices, regulatory requirements and specific needs of LuxTrust. Involved in procedures development and maintain it on annual basis. Participate to the Policy/Standards document review.
•  Assist the IT team in performing risk assessment related to technology implementation :
o Perform research and coordination with IT to drive security
o Perform research and recommendation of appropriate security protection products and services, such as log management, security event management, and intrusion detection
•  Project management of any related project.

Required skills

Qualifications / diploma(s): Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Information Security or related experience.

Years of experience in the area:

• 5+ years of experience in Information Technology with security focus.
• Experience in developing, documenting and maintaining policies, processes, procedures and standards
• Prior security audit experience would be an asset
• Knowledge of and experience in understanding documentation and regulatory compliance requirements is an asset.

Technical competencies:

• Skills and knowledge of IT, networks and Information security business
• PKI knowledge is an asset

Languages: French and English fluent. Any other language is an asset.

Specific skills:

• Strong analytical skills to analyze information security requirements and relate them to appropriate controls
• Organized, responsive, accountable and highly thorough of problem solving oriented and solution driven
• Ability to synthesize
• Proactive attitude
• Good team player and positive attitude in a challenging environment
• Strong communication and writing skills
• Foster teamwork and collaboration

Core competencies at LuxTrust:

• Analytical mindset & decision making
• Organizational fluency
• Personal effectiveness
• Results-driven
• Client service mindset
• Strategic vision
• Leadership

What we offer

• A permanent contract based in Capellen - Luxembourg
• A competitive salary, in accordance with your education and experience.
• Attractive benefits and advantages including an employee benefit plan, a gym, meal vouchers and additional holidays.
• A healthy work-life balance including flex work arrangements.
• Parking spaces for all employees.
• An open and transparent career path.
• Development and growth opportunities in a state-of-the art digital company.

Our company is committed to fair recruitment, based on the skills of each candidate, regardless of gender nationality, sexual orientation, religion, or any other discriminatory criterion.

Arendt & Medernach is the leading independent business law firm in Luxembourg with over 800 professionals. Our firm advises international and domestic clients in all areas of business law relevant to their business activities, ranging from fund formation, banking, insurance, private equity, and real estate to corporate and tax matters.

‎
Group Financial Controller

Reporting directly to the CFO, the role will help build scalable financial governance, robust reporting, and efficient processes across the Group, with a particular focus on foreign offices.
The successful candidate will play a central role in developing the financial infrastructure required to support the Group's international growth, ensuring reliable financial information, strengthening compliance with laws and regulations, and establishing a consistent reporting and control framework. The role will also act as the single Finance point of contact for the partner responsible for the Group's foreign offices.

Your role:

Treasury Management

• Lead and oversee treasury management activities, supported by one full-time team member, including cash flow monitoring, liquidity planning, banking relationships, and related controls.
Financial reporting & consolidation
• Review monthly accounting close activities and ensure the timely and accurate preparation of monthly management reporting across the Group, with a particular focus on foreign offices.
• Implement the group financial consolidation process, including methodology, timetable, reporting framework, and quality controls.

Compliance

• Ensure compliance with all applicable local laws and regulations, including accounting, statutory, and tax obligations.
• Review and redesign the Group's transfer pricing policies, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and evolving business operations.

Internal controls/process

• Optimise finance and accounting processes across the Group, with a particular focus on foreign offices, to improve efficiency, reliability, and scalability.

• Manage relationships with external service providers, including accountants, tax advisers, auditors and other finance-related partners.

Your profile:

• Significant experience in financial control, audit or group reporting, preferably in a professional services, law firm, or multi-entity international environment.
• Experience with treasury management, tax compliance, transfer pricing, and financial consolidation in a multi-GAAP environment.
• Strong understanding of internal controls, process improvement, and finance governance frameworks.

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're looking for a Director, Product Design to lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, reporting to the Co-Founder & Head of Design.

This is a true player-coach role for someone who loves building products as much as leading people. You'll lead and develop a talented team of product designers while remaining deeply embedded in the work itself. You'll whiteboard with designers, navigate complex product decisions.

The Co-Founder & Head of Design remains closely involved in design critique and product quality. Your role is to lead the day-to-day design organization by creating the structure, alignment, and momentum that enable exceptional work. You'll stay two to three layers deeper than the Co-Founder & Head of Design on active initiatives, surfacing the context, tradeoffs, and insights needed to make thoughtful decisions without requiring constant immersion in every project.

Success in this role requires exceptional product judgment, strong design taste, technical fluency, and a collaborative approach. You're someone who naturally connects disciplines, elevates the people around you, and makes both the work and the team better every day.

 
 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, ensuring work is aligned, prioritized, and delivered to an exceptionally high standard.

 - Manage, mentor, and develop a team of product designers, helping them grow their craft, confidence, and impact.

 - Shape and elevate the customer journey

 - Work alongside designers every day by whiteboarding ideas, exploring alternatives, reviewing work in progress, and solving complex product and interaction challenges.

 - Stay deeply informed across active initiatives, surfacing the context and insights that enable the Co-Founder & Head of Design to engage quickly in meaningful design critique and high-impact product decisions.

 - Raise the quality of product design through thoughtful feedback, exceptional craft, and strong design taste.

 - Help evolve Replit's design practices, workflows, and team culture while preserving the speed and flexibility of a high-growth company.

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard exceptional product design talent as the organization grows.

 
 


WHO YOU ARE

You're a builder first and a manager second.

You enjoy being close to the work, helping designers think through difficult problems, and making good teams even better. You're equally comfortable sketching ideas on a whiteboard, giving thoughtful design feedback, coaching a designer through a difficult challenge, or partnering with engineering on implementation details.

You combine exceptional product judgment with strong design taste and technical fluency. You're collaborative, humble, curious, and energized by helping great work happen.

 
 


EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant experience leading product design teams within high-growth technology companies.

 - Proven ability to balance people leadership with meaningful hands-on product design contribution.

 - A portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft, interaction design, product thinking, and systems thinking.

 - Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to deliver technically sophisticated products.

 - Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product development in fast-moving environments.

 - Exceptional communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

 - Strong design taste, sound judgment, and a bias toward action.

 - Experience simplifying complex technical products into elegant, approachable user experiences.

 
 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience designing developer tools, technical products, or software creation platforms.

 - Experience building AI-powered products or AI-native workflows.

 - Coding experience or strong technical curiosity.

 - Experience growing design teams in startup or scale-up environments.

 - Active use of AI throughout your design process.

 
 


WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

This isn't a traditional design leadership role.

We're looking for someone who thrives in the work, not above it. Someone who enjoys solving problems alongside designers, building strong partnerships across Product and Engineering, and bringing the depth of context that allows the Co-Founder & Head of Design to focus on the moments where their perspective has the greatest impact.

This is a role for someone who is excited by complex product challenges, passionate about developing exceptional designers, and motivated by building products that make powerful technology feel intuitive.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for a **Sales Manager** to join North Resort Oy and take responsibility for the active sales of our resort services in both the Finnish and, in particular, international markets.

Your key responsibility will be to build and develop North Resorts sales, with a strong focus on international tour operators, travel agencies and other partners within the travel and tourism industry, as well as direct sales to individual customers.

You will be selling a complete **Lapland travel experience**: high-quality accommodation, restaurant services, winter and summer activities, transportation services, and carefully designed travel packages combining these elements into memorable experiences.

This is a highly hands-on, sales-driven role. We are looking for someone who is proactive, self-motivated and commercially minded. Rather than simply responding to incoming enquiries, you will actively identify new customers and business partners, reach out to them, present North Resorts services and offering, and build strong, long-term customer and partner relationships.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Actively sell North Resorts accommodation, restaurant, activity and transportation services, as well as travel packages

- Build and maintain relationships with international tour operators, travel agencies and travel trade partners

- Actively identify and acquire new international B2B clients and business partners

- Drive direct sales to individual travellers and groups

- Identify customer needs and develop suitable service packages and tailored proposals

- Prepare quotations, conduct sales negotiations and actively close deals

- Manage existing customer relationships and develop opportunities for additional and repeat sales

- Contribute to the product development and commercialisation of North Resorts services and travel packages

- Utilise sales channels, e-commerce platforms and other digital sales solutions effectively

- Actively monitor sales targets, booking levels and occupancy rates

- Participate, where relevant, in international travel trade sales events, workshops, trade fairs and client meetings

- Work closely with the Resort Manager, reception, restaurant and activity teams, as well as external marketing partners

- Monitor, analyse and report on sales performance


WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

- Proven sales experience and a track record of achieving results in customer-facing roles

- A strong sales mindset and genuine motivation for active new customer acquisition

- The ability to build and develop long-term customer and business partnerships

- Excellent customer service, communication and negotiation skills

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Strong digital skills and the ability to work effectively with various sales and customer relationship management (CRM) systems

- A proactive and goal-oriented approach, with the ability to organise and manage your own work independently

- Readiness to work in an international and seasonal tourism environment

- Willingness to travel when required by the role


We particularly value previous experience in international tourism sales, cooperation with tour operators, hotel or resort sales, as well as an established network of contacts within the international travel trade. Additional language skills will be considered a significant advantage.

WHAT WE OFFER

- A unique opportunity to build the sales operations of an entirely new international tourism destination from the ground up

- A high-quality and genuinely distinctive Lapland travel product to represent and sell

- The opportunity to build North Resorts international customer and partner network

- An independent and responsible role where the results of your work have a direct and visible impact

- The opportunity to influence our sales practices, product development and international growth

- Close cooperation with the Resort Manager and the companys management

- Competitive compensation; applicants are welcome to state their salary expectations


Above all, we are looking for a sales professional who genuinely enjoys selling and identifying new customers. You will have the opportunity to play an important role in establishing North Resort as an internationally recognised travel destination and in building its customer base from the very first years of operation.

TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT

- The employment contract is permanent.

- The position is full-time.

- The employment relationship is governed by the Finnish Working Time Act and the applicable collective agreement.

- The role requires occasional flexibility in working hours and the ability to attend customer and sales meetings outside normal office hours when necessary.

- A six-month probationary period will apply in accordance with the Finnish Employment Contracts Act and the applicable collective agreement.

- Salary will be determined based on the responsibilities of the position and the successful candidates qualifications and experience. The position offers a competitive fixed salary plus the opportunity to earn a performance-based sales incentive. Applicants are welcome to state their salary expectations.

- Before commencing employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide an acceptable medical certificate confirming their fitness for the position.

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Engineer for our client.

Your role and responsibilities:
We are now looking for a (Senior) Project Engineer to join our team at Digital Systems, ELDS in Vaasa. In this position you will design, implement and commission automation and communication systems for the electrification of industrial plants, data centers, wind/solar plants and utility substations. You will succeed in this role if you are innovative, organized, and have the ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Due to the nature of the work and location of the development lab, majority of the work is Vaasa based.

You will be mainly accountable for: 
 Planning of the control system for the customer electrification networks 
 The implementation of the automation systems in the customer projects 
 Configuration of the Zenon based SCADA control system (ZEE600) 
 Customer specific HMI implementation of the Zenon based SCADA system
 Engineering of communication devices and system
 Participation of the cyber security implementation for the customer delivery projects.
 System testing in Vaasa laboratory as well as on customer sites 
 Co-operating with customer representatives with a continuous development approach 

Qualifications for the role:
 B.Sc. or M.Sc. level degree from Information, Automation or Communication Technology 
 Solid (> 5 years) relevant work experience from automation and control system engineering 
 Engineering experience of SCADA controls system 
 Knowledge in substation communication protocols (eg. IEC61850, IEC60870-5-104, Modbus)
 Excellent English and Finnish, both written and spoken 
 The ability to build customer relationships with a long-term focus 
 A proactive and systematic way of working 
 Possibility to travel (average 25 days/year)

- Are you fluent in both Finnish and English, verbally and in writing?*
- Are you able to work primarily from Vaasa and travel approximately 25 days per year when required?*

Please apply with your CV in English, clearly showing how you match the requirements and answer to the questions above. The client is continously reviewing candidates and we ask you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Other requirements: Requirements:

jobs.description:
Sejlmager, Sadelmager eller bare snild med hænderne.

Velkommen til Schultz Sejlmageri ApS

Vi søger en ny kollega til vores systue/sejlloft i Kolding – en dygtig håndværker med flair for syning og sans for kvalitet. Har du erfaring med kalecher, sejl, telte eller autosadelmageri? Eller måske bare hænderne skruet rigtigt på og lyst til at arbejde i en niche, hvor ingen dage er ens? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

Du bliver en vigtig del af vores produktion, hvor vi udvikler, opmåler og syr kalecher, sprayhoods og sejl til både samt diverse industrielle afdækninger. Du kommer også til at bidrage til den generelle udvikling af virksomheden og vores produkter. Er du uddannet sejlmager så vil du komme til at stå for vores sejlloft som indebærer kunderådgivning, reparationer af sejl, opmåling og montering samt bestilling af nye sejl hos det anerkendte mærke Hyde Sails.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Opmåling, tilpasning og syning af kalecher, sprayhoods og sejl

  • Arbejde med forskellige materialer og specialopgaver

  • Kvalitetskontrol og løbende forbedringer i processer og produkter

  • Samarbejde med kolleger i en travl og alsidig hverdag

Hvem er du?

Du behøver ikke være uddannet sejlmager – men du skal have erfaring med håndværksfag, hvor præcision og kvalitet er i fokus. Måske har du arbejdet med autosadelmageri, telte, møbelpolstring eller noget helt fjerde?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er dygtig til håndværk og har erfaring med syning

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Bevarer overblikket i travle perioder

  • Er løsningsorienteret og kvalitetsbevidst

  • Trives i en mindre virksomhed med stor frihed

Hvem er vi?

Schultz Sejlmageri er en mindre virksomhed fra 1897 med ca. 8 medarbejdere. det startede som en læderforretning med seletøj, som senere blev til autopolstring og fra 70erne var det primært bådbranchen der blev produceret til. vi levere til både private og erhverv, i både ind- og udland.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Gode fysiske rammer og flextid

  • En hverdag med frihed under ansvar

  • Mulighed for at præge din egen rolle

  • Et uhøjtideligt miljø med passion for faget

  • løn efter kvalifikationer

Klar til at komme med ombord?

Send din ansøgning og evt. CV til info@schultz-sejl.dk – eller kig forbi os på Hesselly 8, 6000 Kolding. mærk ansøgningen med Sejlmager.

Har du spørgsmål? Ring til Nicolai Schultz på 76 32 12 00.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette.

Skal vi sy noget stort sammen?✂️

jobs.description:
AJONEUVOASENTAJA / KORJAAMOPÄÄLLIKKÖ

**ModHaus Autokorjaamo Oy – Hyvinkää**

ModHaus Autokorjaamo Oy on uusi, kasvava ja kehittyvä autokorjaamo Hyvinkäällä. Haemme nyt joukkoomme **kokenutta ajoneuvoasentajaa / korjaamopäällikköä**, joka haluaa ottaa vastuuta korjaamon päivittäisestä toiminnasta ja olla mukana rakentamassa yrityksestä juuri sellaisen kuin siitä parhaimmillaan voi tulla.

Tässä tehtävässä et ole vain asentaja muiden joukossa. Etsimme henkilöä, joka haluaa **ottaa vastuuta, kehittää toimintaa ja vaikuttaa siihen, mihin suuntaan yritys tulevaisuudessa menee.**

TEHTÄVÄ

Korjaamopäällikkönä vastaat korjaamon päivittäisestä toiminnasta yhdessä toimitusjohtajan kanssa. Työhön kuuluu sekä käytännön korjaamotyötä että korjaamon johtamiseen ja kehittämiseen liittyviä tehtäviä.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- Ajoneuvojen vianhaku, diagnostiikka ja korjaaminen

- Huolto- ja korjaustöiden suunnittelu ja työnjohto

- Asiakaspalvelu ja asiakkaiden kanssa asiointi

- Tarjouslaskenta ja töiden hinnoittelu

- Työmääräysten tekeminen ja töiden aikataulutus

- Varaosien ja tarvikkeiden tilaaminen

- Korjaamon päivittäisen toiminnan organisointi

- Työn laadun ja tehokkuuden seuranta

- Reklamaatioiden ja haastavien asiakastilanteiden hoitaminen

- Korjaamon toimintatapojen, palveluiden ja työskentelyn kehittäminen

- Työkalujen, laitteiden ja muiden hankintojen suunnittelu

- Muut korjaamopäällikön tehtävät


Tehtävässä pääset siis tekemään monipuolisesti **sekä käsillä että päällä**.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on vähintään noin **2–5 vuoden kokemus ajoneuvoalalta** ja joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti.

Sinulta odotamme erityisesti:

- Vahvaa ajoneuvojen teknistä osaamista

- Kykyä itsenäiseen vianhakuun ja vaativampienkin korjausten tekemiseen

- Oma-aloitteisuutta

- Vastuuntuntoa

- Hyviä asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- Ongelmanratkaisukykyä

- Kykyä organisoida ja priorisoida työtehtäviä

- Halua kehittää sekä itseäsi että työpaikkaa

- Yrittäjähenkistä ja rakentavaa asennetta


**VAG-osaaminen katsotaan erityiseksi eduksi**, mutta haemme ennen kaikkea hyvää ja monipuolista ajoneuvoalan ammattilaista.

B-ajokortti on tehtävässä välttämätön.

MITÄ ME TARJOAMME?

ModHaus on uusi yritys, joten tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan asioihin tavalla, joka ei välttämättä ole mahdollista suuremmissa ja valmiiksi organisoiduissa korjaamoissa.

**Sinun ei tarvitse vain sopeutua valmiisiin toimintatapoihin – pääset rakentamaan niitä kanssamme.**

Kuuntelemme työntekijöiden kehitysehdotuksia ja haluamme antaa korjaamopäällikölle mahdollisimman hyvät mahdollisuudet kehittää toimintaa. Keskustelemme asioista yhdessä toimitusjohtajan kanssa, mutta tehtävässä on **suhteellisen vapaat kädet viedä korjaamoa haluttuun suuntaan**.

Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan esimerkiksi:

- Korjaamon toimintatapoihin

- Työkaluihin ja laitteisiin

- Palveluiden kehittämiseen

- Varaosahankintoihin ja yhteistyökumppaneihin

- Hinnoitteluun ja työn tehokkuuteen

- Asiakaspalveluun

- Korjaamon tulevaisuuden suuntaan


Ja mikä tärkeintä, **onnistuessasi sinulla on mahdollisuus kasvaa yrityksen mukana.**

MAHDOLLISUUS OSAKKUUTEEN

Tehtävässä on **mahdollisuus myöhemmässä vaiheessa yrityksen osakkuuteen**.

Etsimme siis henkilöä, joka ei välttämättä halua olla vain työntekijä, vaan jolla on halua ja kiinnostusta olla rakentamassa ModHausista pitkäjänteisesti menestyvää yritystä.

TYÖSUHDE

- **Tehtävä:** Ajoneuvoasentaja / Korjaamopäällikkö

- **Työsuhde:** Vakituinen

- **Työaika:** 37,5 h / viikko

- **Aloitus:** Mahdollisimman pian

- **Palkkaus:** Sopimuksen ja kokemuksen mukaan

- **Työpaikka:** Hyvinkää


KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos kuulostaa siltä, että tämä voisi olla sinun paikkasi, **lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille itsestäsi, työkokemuksestasi sekä siitä, millaisena näet hyvän ja toimivan autokorjaamon.**

Hakemuksen voit lähettää sähköpostitse osoitteeseen:

**sami@modhaus.fi**

Voit hakea myös suoraan ilmoituksen hakulinkin kautta.

jobs.title: PhD fellowship - Computational Models for Improved Assessment of Diastolic Function
jobs.description:
A 3-year PhD-fellowship is available at the Intervention Centre at Oslo University Hospital. This is one out of two fellowships at The Intervention Centre that is part of the Cardiovascular Digital Twin network comprising a total of 15 fellowships across Europe (https://www.cdtnet.eu/). The project is funded by the European Research Council’s MSCA program.

Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply!


Arbeidsoppgaver

Project and Job Description


Heart failure affects millions of people worldwide, and around half of all cases are linked to problems with the heart's ability to relax and fill properly during diastole. Although echocardiography is the most commonly used imaging technique for assessing cardiac function, many of the key factors responsible for diastolic dysfunction—such as myocardial stiffness, impaired relaxation, and elevated filling pressures—cannot be measured directly using current non-invasive methods.


This project aims to improve the assessment of diastolic function by combining echocardiographic measurements with patient-specific digital twin technology. The doctoral candidate will develop mathematical models that link clinically acquired echocardiographic data to the underlying physiological and mechanical properties of the heart. By integrating imaging information with computational models, the project seeks to estimate clinically important parameters that are otherwise difficult to measure without invasive procedures.


While the main focus of the project is the integration of conventional echocardiographic measurements with computational models of cardiac function, there will also be opportunities to investigate emerging ultrasound modalities such as blood speckle tracking (BST). BST provides information about intracardiac flow dynamics and can be used to derive parameters such as intraventricular pressure gradients, energy loss, and flow vortices. The clinical utility of these measurements and their relationship to filling pressures and diastolic function will be explored.


The candidate will participate in the collection and analysis of animal and clinical datasets, including echocardiographic studies with simultaneously recorded invasive pressure measurements. These data will be used to develop, calibrate, and validate the proposed modelling approaches. Ultimately, the project aims to create more accurate and clinically useful tools for diagnosing and monitoring heart failure, supporting earlier intervention and more personalised patient care.

The PhD-fellow will be based at the Intervention Centre at Oslo University Hospital where the work will be conducted in an interdisciplinary team of research scientists, surgeons, engineers, and university researchers. The employment period is three years (commencing approximately December 2026), including the objective of taking organized academic training (university courses) and the completion of the PhD degree. Admission to a doctoral degree program is a requirement; including undertaking a total of 30 credits coursework from University in Oslo’s (UiO) PhD courses. For regulations concerning the PhD degree at UiO, see: https://www.uio.no/english/research/phd

 

Planned Research stays


●        King's College London, United Kingdom (2 months): training in advanced cardiac digital twin and heart modelling technologies.
●        Maastricht University, Netherlands (1 month): training in the CircAdapt cardiovascular modelling platform and model personalisation methods.

  Kvalifikasjoner (overskrift)

Desirable Project-Specific Qualifications and Skills

  • We seek a motivated, creative, and enthusiastic candidate with a strong interest in interdisciplinary research at the interface of engineering, mathematics, and medicine.
  • Applicants should hold a Master's degree (or equivalent) in Cybernetics, Electrical Engineering, Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, Biomedical Engineering, Medical Technology, or a related discipline.
  • A strong academic record is required with a weighted average grade of B or higher.
  • Experience with scientific programming (e.g., Python, MATLAB, or similar languages) is advantageous.
  • Knowledge of mathematical modelling, computational mechanics, or data science is considered an advantage.
  • Interest in cardiovascular physiology, echocardiography, medical technology, or computational medicine is desirable.
  • Experience with experimental, pre-clinical, or clinical research, including data collection, validation studies, or analysis of biomedical data, is an advantage.
  • Previous research experience, including scientific publications, conference presentations, or research projects, is beneficial.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.
  • The successful candidate should be able to work independently while also contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary research team.

Important Eligibility Rule (MSCA Mobility Rule)

This position is funded by the European Research Council's MSCA program. To apply, you must meet a strict international mobility rule.

Who CANNOT apply: Anyone who has lived, worked, or studied in Norway for more than 12 months in total during the last 3 years.

Who CAN apply: Anyone who has spent less than 12 months in Norway during the last 3 years (including those who have never been to Norway).

We offer
  • Standard Norwegian PhD fellowship salary according to agreement with labour union
  • Professional development in a friendly and stimulating multi-disciplinary and international working environment
  • Attractive welfare arrangements

 

Application documents:

Short statement on the applicant’s personal qualifications and motivation for the position
Applicant's CV (including list of publications and relevant former positions)
Academic transcripts and degree certificates, with official translation in English
Short statement from a former supervisor/tutor/teacher

Mitä työ sisältää?

Työssäsi palvelet matkailijoita ja yritysasiakkaita kasvotusten, puhelimitse ja sähköpostitse. Huolehdit autonvuokrauksiin liittyvistä käytännön asioista sekä autat asiakkaita löytämään juuri heidän tarpeisiinsa sopivat tuotteet ja palvelut.

Tässä työssä onnistut, jos

- nautit asiakaspalvelusta ja ihmisten kohtaamisesta

- sinulla on myönteinen ja oma-aloitteinen asenne

- uskallat suositella ja myydä asiakkaalle lisäpalveluita

- toimit rauhallisesti myös kiireessä

- puhut sujuvasti suomea ja englantia

- sinulla on voimassa oleva B-ajokortti


Mitä tarjoamme?

- Tuntipalkan **12,50 €/h**

- **Myyntiprovisiot ilman kattoa**. Mitä paremmin onnistut, sitä enemmän ansaitset.

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää myynti- ja asiakaspalvelutaitojasi

- Kannustavan tiimin ja kansainvälisen työympäristön

- SIXTin henkilöstöedut


Työtä tehdään vuoroissa toimipisteiden aukioloaikojen mukaisesti. Joustavuus työaikojen suhteen auttaa sinua menestymään tehtävässä. Tehtävä on kokoaikainen (37,5h/vko) ja määräaikainen helmikuun loppuun asti.

jobs.title: Fleksibel Social- og sundhedsassistent søges til respiratorisk barselsvikariat fra 1. december med mulighed for fastansætteæse.
jobs.description:
Vi søger en social- og sundhedsassistent til to piger i hver sin invasive respiratoriske ordning i henholdsvis Slagelse og Kastrup. Stillingerne omfatter samlet 10 dagvagter fordelt på de 2 ordninger.

Pigen i Kastrup

Den unge pige har en medfødt hjerneskade, er uden verbalt sprog og har behov for omfattende pleje døgnet rundt, herunder 24-timers invasiv respiratorisk overvågning.

Hun bor hjemme hos sin far, som er en aktiv og vigtig del af hendes pleje. For at kunne yde den bedst mulige omsorg er det vigtigt, at du lærer hendes mimik, signaler og individuelle udtryk at kende. Plejen tilpasses løbende ud fra hendes symptomer, behov og dagsform.

Der er kat i hjemmet, og der er gode parkeringsmuligheder lige foran huset.

Pigen i Slangerup

Den unge pige bor på et bosted i Slangerup. Hun har Cerebral Parese og behov for hjælp i alle daglige aktiviteter. Hun har epilepsi, som håndteres af bostedets personale.

Hun har ikke et verbalt sprog, men kommunikerer gennem øjenkontakt og mimik. Hun er glad for aktiviteter og et aktivt hverdagsliv, og du vil derfor følge hende i forskellige gøremål såsom:

  • Svømning med sine forældre, hvor du overvåger fra bassinkanten

  • Udendørsaktiviteter og oplevelser i det fri

Fælles for begge ordninger er

  • Respiratorisk overvågning og invasiv behandling

  • Observation og håndtering af respiratorisk udstyr

  • Medicingivning og sondeernæring

  • Dokumentation og løbende observation af borgerens tilstand

  • Samarbejde med team, forældre, hjemmepleje/bostedets medarbejdere

  • Deltagelse i borgerens daglige aktiviteter og rutiner

  • At skabe ro, stabilitet og tryghed på dine vagter

Der udføres ingen personlig pleje i denne ordning. Din primære opgave er respiratorisk behandling, overvågning og håndtering af det respiratoriske udstyr.

Om jobbet 

Du skal være uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent, og meget gerne være have arbejdet som respiratorisk overvåger i en invasiv ordning. Men har du ikke certifikat, og ellers det rette match, så sørger vi for oplæringen og certificering på RCØ (Respiratorisk Center Øst).

Som del af teamet har du ansvar for;

  • Respiratorisk overvågning og behandling

  • Medicingivning og sondeernæring

  • Observation og dokumentation

  • At skabe ro, stabilitet og tryghed på dine vagter

Vagter

Der er 10 dagvagter fordelt over 6 ugers rul også weekend. Vagtlængden er 12 timer og 15 minutter. 

  • Dagvagt: kl. 07.00-19.15

Stillingen kræver, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar og bidrage til et trygt og stabilt miljø for pigerne gennem hele vagten. 

Derudover arbejder vi med selvdækkende teams, hvilket betyder at teamet selv dækker ledige vagter ved bla. sygdom og ferie. Derfor har vi forventning om at vores kommende medarbejder er fleksibel. Oplæringen foregår både på dag vagt og nattevagt, der ligger fra kl. 19.00-7.15. Dette er for at få indblik i de daglige rutiner og have mulighed for at træde til ved sygdom.

Om dig

  • Du er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent

  • Har respiratorisk erfaring

  • Er rolig, ansvarsbevidst og selvstændig

  • Motiveres af at arbejde 1:1 i et roligt og struktureret miljø på flere ordninger

  • Er fleksibel og forstår værdien af at være en del af et selvdækkende team

  • Trives i et privat hjem/bosted og i dit eget selskab – også på nattevagter

  • Har bil og trives med at arbejde i forskellige hjem.

Vi tilbyder:    

✔ Faste vagter
✔ God work-life balance
✔ Grundig oplæring og certificering
✔ Mulighed for ekstra vagter

Hvorfor Olivia Danmark?
 Vi hylder mangfoldighed og skaber plads til både grin og omsorg i hverdagen. Samtidig får du rammer, der gør arbejdet både professionelt og personligt givende:

  • Grundig oplæring

  • Fast 6-ugers vagtrul

  • En fast områdeleder, der lytter og støtter

  • Personalemøder og supervision

  • Fællesskab, medindflydelse og gensidig fleksibilitet

Hos os er det vigtigt, at vi passer på både vores borgere og hinanden.

Ansøgning og kontakt 

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.   

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Kitt Borum Rusborg på mail kitt.rusborg@oliviadanmark.dk eller telefon +45 71 92 40 75

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel @ Nightingale Health
jobs.description:
Hey lawyer with a couple of years of work experience!

Do you want to help create a healthier world – and you know that in a growth company that means hard work, shifting challenges, and the perseverance to see things through? Do you see yourself thriving as a member of a team that wants to create something new (rather than to just repeat and secure the old)? Are you committed to keep learning and growing professionally to be able to help shape better healthcare for the world?

If you responded **YES**, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **Nightingale Health** as their new **Legal Counsel**!

_Chronic diseases cause around 75% of deaths globally and place a growing burden on healthcare systems. The way to address this is preventive healthcare, but until recently the tools to detect disease risks at population scale have not existed. Nightingale Health has built them. The Nightingale Health Check is a blood-based risk detection test that identifies risks for multiple chronic diseases, including cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, kidney disease, and fatty liver disease, from a single blood sample. It is designed to be applied population-wide, so healthcare systems can identify the people who would benefit most from preventive action before disease develops._

_Nightingale Health's technology is validated in over 900 peer-reviewed scientific publications and is used in many of the world's leading health studies, including the UK Biobank. In Finland, the Nightingale Health Check is in nationwide healthcare use, and over 200,000 people have already received their results. Nightingale Health operates globally with a parent company in Finland and subsidiaries in countries such as Japan, the United States, Singapore, and the United Kingdom, and has customers in more than 34 countries across healthcare and medical research. The company's Series B shares are listed on the Main Market of Nasdaq Helsinki and on the OTCQX International market. Read more about Nightingale Health_ **_here_**_._

**At Nightingale Health, you will join** an agile and commercially focused Helsinki-based Legal Team of two lawyers, and report to the General Counsel. You will be based in Nightingale Health's bright and modern office located in Tilkka, Helsinki. The team works flexibly, but frequent office presence is highly appreciated.

**In your day-to-day work,** you will work with a wide range of legal topics covering the entire geographical footprint of Nightingale Health. For example, you will provide legal advice in various fields of law, such as intellectual property, data protection, healthcare and medical device laws and regulations, as well as draft and negotiate different types of agreements, such as sales, R&D and service agreements. You will also manage intellectual property rights and develop and oversee internal legal policies and educate your colleagues on legal topics. In addition, you will manage corporate governance and legal matters relating to the listed parent company, as well as legal matters for the group's nine subsidiaries.

**You could be the candidate we are looking for, if:**

- you have a growth mindset and enjoy constant learning – at Nightingale Health, things move fast and every team member is expected to grow along with the company;

- you identify yourself as a generalist rather than a specialist – agile allocation of tasks is crucial in a small legal team;

- you are eager to take an active role not only when it comes to legal topics, but to learn and consider commercial aspects, as well; and

- you are pragmatic, solutions-oriented, and communicate fluently in both Finnish and English.


**Nightingale Health offers you:**

**A unique work environment:** you get to join an international working environment and to work with a multidisciplinary team of scientists, business professionals, developers, designers as well as biotech business experts who have developed a pioneering health check that provides risk detection for multiple chronic diseases from a single blood sample.

**A commercial legal role:** there are lawyers who enjoy sitting on the sidelines reading the rulebook, and then there are lawyers who want to join the game and play alongside the business. We are looking for the latter type!

**A team with a shared mission:** you will work with trusting, helping and people-oriented colleagues whose mission is to build sustainable healthcare and reduce health inequalities.

**An opportunity for professional growth:** Nightingale Health's high-paced environment offers you an opportunity to constantly develop professionally – we can guarantee that you will not feel stagnated!

**Benefits to support your well-being:** besides industry-standard salary and eligibility for Nightingale Health's stock option program, you will receive a wide scale of benefits to support your health and well-being – of which we are happy to tell you more in our conversations.

We are looking for a highly motivated, proactive individual who thrives in a fast-paced exciting environment and is driven to deliver winning results.

**What will help you succeed:**

- **Leadership:** Proven ability to lead cross-functional and remote teams, influence without authority, and drive alignment across departments.

- **Ownership:** Energetic and committed to achieving results. You take initiative, overcome obstacles, and pursue opportunities with determination.

- **Strategic Thinking**: Ability to see the broader business context and align tender strategies with long-term objectives.

- **Tender Management**: Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tenders simultaneously under tight deadlines.

- **Commercial Acumen**: Deep understanding of pricing models, contract terms, and financial implications of bids. Ability to assess risks, evaluate scenarios, and make data-driven decisions.

- **Communication**: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both internal coordination and external client interaction.

- **Resilience**: Comfortable working under pressure and adapting to changing priorities.

- **Education**: Bachelors or Masters degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field.


- **Experience:** Several years of experience in tendering, bid management, or commercial project roles. Experience working in matrix organizations and coordinating across business units is beneficial. Familiarity with public and private sector procurement processes.

- **Language:** Fluent in English; Nordic language is a plus.


**Why Schneider Electric?**

At Schneider Electric, we are committed to fostering a vibrant and inclusive work culture where every employee is empowered to thrive. As part of our team, you can expect:

- **Professional Growth**: Access to continuous learning opportunities, mentorship programs, and career development resources to nurture your potential and drive your career forward.

- **Inclusive Community:** Join a diverse and inclusive community where your unique perspectives are celebrated, and your voice is heard, fostering an environment of collaboration and belonging.

jobs.title: Ophthalmologist – Hospital in Eastern Norway
jobs.description:
On behalf of a well-established public hospital in Eastern Norway, we are seeking a ophthalmologist for a permanent position within a specialist ophthalmology department.

The hospital is located in a well-connected urban area in Eastern Norway, within easy reach of Oslo and surrounded by opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year. The area offers an attractive combination of city life, nature and family-friendly communities, with good transport connections to both the capital and the rest of the region.

 

About the position

 

You will become part of an experienced specialist environment providing assessment, treatment and follow-up of patients with a broad range of ophthalmic conditions.

 

Your responsibilities will be adapted to your qualifications, experience and professional interests and may include:

  • Outpatient consultations, examinations and patient follow-up
  • Diagnosis and treatment of ophthalmic conditions
  • Ophthalmic procedures and surgery according to your qualifications and experience
  • Preoperative assessment and postoperative follow-up
  • Collaboration with other medical specialties and healthcare professionals
  • Participation in multidisciplinary meetings and quality-improvement initiatives
  • Participation in the on-call rota according to your level of competence
  • Supervision and training of colleagues and medical students where relevant

The position offers the opportunity to work within the Norwegian public healthcare system, where multidisciplinary collaboration, professional autonomy and high-quality patient care are central to everyday clinical practice.

 

Who are we looking for?

 

We are looking for an ophthalmologist who:

  • Is a specialist in ophthalmology 
  • Holds a medical degree from an EU/EEA country
  • Has relevant clinical experience within ophthalmology
  • Is comfortable working independently and making clinical decisions
  • Enjoys working as part of a multidisciplinary team
  • Has good communication and collaboration skills
  • Is motivated to relocate to Norway and learn Norwegian

Before starting in the position, you will need:

  • Norwegian medical authorisation
  • Norwegian specialist approval in ophthalmology
  • Norwegian language skills at minimum B2 level

You do not need to have these in place when you apply. Dignus Medical will guide you through the authorisation and specialist approval process and provide the language training needed before you start working in Norway.

 

What can you expect?

  • A permanent position within the Norwegian public healthcare system
  • A varied clinical role adapted to your experience and professional interests
  • An experienced and supportive specialist environment
  • Close multidisciplinary collaboration
  • Opportunities for professional development and continuing education
  • A good balance between professional opportunities and life outside work
  • Free Norwegian language training
  • Support throughout the authorisation and relocation process

Moving to Norway

 

Relocating to another country is about more than finding the right position. Our role is to make the transition as smooth as possible.

 

Dignus Medical has extensive experience recruiting medical specialists from across Europe to Norway and will support you throughout the entire process.

 

We assist with:

  • Assessment of your qualifications and documentation
  • Norwegian medical authorisation
  • Norwegian specialist approval
  • Free Norwegian language training
  • Practical matters related to relocation
  • Preparation for your new workplace and life in Norway
  • Personal follow-up before, during and after your relocation

For Swedish and Danish specialists, the transition to working and living in Norway can be particularly straightforward due to the similarities between the Scandinavian healthcare systems, languages and working cultures.

 

Interested?

 

Apply today or get in touch with us for more information. We would be happy to tell you more about the position!

 

You can also register your CV or sign up for our newsletter to stay updated on future opportunities.

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film and join us on our journey!

jobs.title: Barselsvikar som idrætskoordinator i socialpsykiatrien
jobs.description:
Så er chancen her for at blive vores nye idrætskoordinator i en periode. Vores nuværende idrætskoordinator skal på barsel og vi søger derfor hendes afløser i perioden fra d 1-11 2026 til forventelig sommer 2027.

Har du erfaring med idræt og brænder du for at udvikle fællesskaber for mennesker med psykiske sårbarheder?

Du vil være en del af socialpsykiatrien, som består af et bofællesskab, et midlertidigt botilbud for unge samt dagsbeskæftigelse, bostøtte og café. Derudover er der et senhjerneskadeområde ligeledes med dagsbeskæftigelse og bostøtte.

Idrætskoordinatoren skal dække ovenstående områder.

Derudover har psykiatrien en meget velfungerende idrætsforening, LIF, - Limfjordens idrætsforening. Foreningen blev stiftet i september 2015 med henblik på at skabe et meningsfuldt og aktivt fællesskab for psykisk sårbare borgere i Morsø kommune. Foreningen er under Dansk Arbejder Idræt og har et samarbejde med Idræt for Sindet foreninger i hele Danmark.

Som Idrætskoordinator skal du arbejde tæt sammen tæt med bestyrelsen i idrætsforeningen om at arrangere aktiviteter og arrangementer både lokalt og ved deltagelse i idrætsarrangementer/stævner i andre kommuner sammen med borgerne.

Som idrætskoordinator bliver du både koordinator, igangsætter, instruktør og støtteperson i foreningen. Der vil også være praktiske opgaver og der vil være administrative opgaver i forhold til driften af LIF.

Fagligt forventer vi, at du;

  • Har en idrætsprofil og en relevant uddannelse, som f.eks pædagog, fysioterapeut, ergoterapeut, lærer eller har en uddannelse indenfor idræt og sundhed eller tilsvarende
  • Har erfaring med frivillige foreninger, enten som træner, instruktør eller lignende og kan indgå i samarbejde med frivillige foreninger
  • Evner at tilpasse din træning og instruktion efter deltagernes niveau og særligt i forhold til ikke idrætsvante mennesker
  • Har erfaring med eller viden om de udfordringer, psykisk sårbare mennesker har i dagligdagen
  • Har erfaring med at motivere andre

Vi forestiller os, at du som person:

  • Er engageret og empatisk og vil møde borgerne med et åbent og anerkendende sind
  • Har et godt og smittende humør
  • Har en indfaldsvinkel, der er motiverende, støttende og inspirerende for den enkelte
  • Har forståelse for forskelligheden båret af respekt for andre
  • Er rolig og tydelig i din kommunikation
  • Brænder for at gøre en forskel
  • Er selvstændig og kan tage ansvar
  • Har det fint med, at mange timer og aktiviteter kan ligge efter kl. 16
  • Kan samarbejde tværfagligt med kollegaer på alle område

 

Vores mission er at styrke borgernes mestring i eget liv, i samspil med det omgivende samfund, så vi bidrager til øget inklusion. Det handler både om at skabe tryghed for borgeren og øget selvstændighed. Vores indsats baserer sig på at møde den enkelte borger, via den nære og anerkendende relation, samt tage udgangspunkt i dennes kompetencer. 

 

Løn- og ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst. Desuden fastsættes lønnen efter aftale og under medvirken af den forhandlingsberettede organisation.

For yderligere oplysninger eller spørgsmål kontakt leder Inge Kappel på tlf. 99 70 66 64.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 17. september 2026.

Samtaler forventes afholdt d 28. september 2026.

Der vil blive søgt en straffeattest inden ansættelsen og denne skal være forenelig med ansættelse.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.description:

Haussa on määräaikaiseen osa-aikaiseen (22,5 h/3 vkoa) työsuhteeseen

SALIAPULAINEN/TARJOILIJA, AMARILLO, LAS PALMAS & VENN KOTKA

Kotkan Amarillo, Las Palmas ja VENN kutsuvat viihtymään maukkaiden elämysten pariin. Monipuolinen ruokatarjonta, raikkaat juomat ja rento tunnelma luovat täydelliset puitteet niin illalliselle kuin yhteisiin hetkiin ystävien ja perheen kanssa. Tähän kokonaisuuteen kaipaamme vahvistukseksi työkaveria, joka on sanavalmis asiakaspalvelija ja luotettava tiimipelaaja. Meillä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisessa ympäristössä, jossa jokainen ilta on erilainen ja työt ihan tavallisia.

Olet äärimmäisen tärkeässä roolissa toteuttamassa asiakkaille ikimuistoisia iltoja ja rentoja hetkiä hyvän juoman ja tunnelman äärellä. Huolehdit omalta osaltasi nopeasta palvelusta ja tilojen siisteydestä. Tehtävänimike ja palkkaus määräytyvät aiemman kokemuksesi mukaan. Ilman alan aiempaa kokemusta, aloitat tehtävässä saliapulaisena, kokeneempana ravintola-alan osaajana voit työskennellä suoraan tarjoilijana, jolloin osallistut myös anniskeluun ja muuhun tarjoilijalle tyypilliseen työhön.

Hakijoilta toivomme:
💡 Hyvää asiakaspalveluasennetta sekä iloista ja energistä työotetta asiakkaiden ja työkavereiden iloksi.
💡 Hyvää paineensietokykyä ja joustavuutta. Meille se tarkoittaa sitä, että pääsi pysyy kylmänä myös kiireisinä hetkinä ja jaksat pysyä positiivisena myös silloin, kun työtehtävät vaihtuvat nopeasti ja yllättäen.
💡 Kyvykkyyttä fyysisesti raskaaseen työhön. Työpäivät kuluvat pääosin jalkojen päällä, askeleita kertyy päivittäin tuhansia ja ergonomiasta huolimatta työhön kuuluu esimerkiksi raskaita nostoja.
💡 Alan työkokemus katsotaan eduksi, mutta ei ole välttämätöntä, sillä suurin osa työtehtävistä on opetettavissa. Hygienia- ja anniskelupassit katsomme eduksi.

Työn luonteen ja työvuorojen vuoksi hakijan tulee olla täysi-ikäinen. Työkielemme on suomi. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi. Lisäksi edellytämme valmiutta työskennellä kaikkina ravintoloiden aukioloaikoina, myös yövuoroissa.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
💚 Lokakuussa alkavan määräaikaisen työsuhteen, joka jatkuu tammikuuhun 2027 saakka.
💚 Kattavan perehdytyksen, jotta pystyt suoriutumaan työstäsi parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.
💚 Matkailu- ja ravintola-alan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen tuntipalkan (8,38-12,91 €/h, palkkaryhmä 1, Saliapulainen) tai (9,59-15,04 €/h, palkkaryhmä 4, Tarjoilija), jonka suuruuteen aiempi kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi vaikuttavat.
💚 S-Ryhmän ylivoimaiset henkilöstöedut, jotka ovat käytettävissä kautta koko Suomen heti työsuhteen alusta alkaen.

Lisätiedot ja rekrytoinnin aikataulu

📌 Tiedotamme rekrytoinnin etenemisestä kaikille hakijoille joko sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse. Seuraathan siis myös sähköpostin roskapostikansiota ja vastaat 010-alkuisiin numeroihin, joista yleisimmin soitamme.

jobs.title: Assistant Professors and/or Associate Professors in Clinical and Preventive Odontology
jobs.description:
Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark is seeking two motivated individuals for two fixed-term appointments (2 years, up to 37 hours per week, with the possibility of extension). The successful candidates will have the opportunity to contribute to the establishment of the newly established Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and to play an active role in the development of the upcoming educational programmes for dentists and dental hygienists.

These positions offer a rare opportunity to influence the development of education, research, and clinical teaching from the very beginning, while joining an ambitious academic community dedicated to excellence, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

About the positions

We are seeking candidates with a broad background in dentistry and an interest in the development of university education.

We welcome applicants with diverse dental competencies and subspecialties, for example within:

  • Cariology and Endodontics

  • Periodontology

  • Prosthodontics

  • Orthodontics

  • Oral Surgery

  • Oral Medicine

  • Paediatric Dentistry

  • Clinical Dentistry in General

  • Preventive Dentistry

  • Digital Dentistry

The decisive factor is not your subspecialty alone, but your commitment to contributing to the development of a modern, research-led education in dentistry.

 

Main responsibilities

 

As part of the establishment and development of the department, you will be expected to contribute actively to:

  • the development of the new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, which are expected to commence in the summer of 2027

  • the planning and development of courses and teaching activities

  • teaching at both undergraduate and graduate levels

  • teaching dentistry and dental hygiene students

  • the development of clinical learning activities, simulation-based training, and competency-based education

  • student assessment and supervision

  • collaboration with clinical instructors, private training clinics, and other external partners

  • the development of the department’s teaching and learning environment

  • the development and implementation of research projects within clinical and preventive dentistry

  • scientific publishing and dissemination of research findings

  • the development of national and international research collaborations

  • securing external research funding and contributing to grant applications

Teaching will be based on evidence-based dentistry and will emphasize the close integration of basic sciences, clinical skills, and patient care.

Research

The department is concurrently establishing the Research Unit APEX, which aims to build strong national and international research environments within clinical and preventive dentistry.

We are therefore seeking candidates with an interest in research and academic development.

To be successful in this position, we expect you:

  • have documented research experience

  • have published scientific articles in peer-reviewed journals

  • are motivated to further develop your own research profile

  • have an interest in interdisciplinary and international collaboration.

The research component of the position will be tailored to the individual candidate’s qualifications and career stage.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

  • hold a degree in Dentistry

  • have obtained a PhD degree

  • hold Danish authorization to practice as a dentist, or meet the requirements for obtaining Danish authorization

  • combine strong clinical competencies with a well-developed scientific and analytical mindset

  • are motivated to contribute actively to the development of a new dental department

  • thrive in an interdisciplinary university environment

  • possess strong collaborative and interpersonal skills.

In addition, the following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • documented teaching experience

  • experience with curriculum development

  • experience supervising students

  • experience from specialist training or other advanced areas of clinical expertise.

For candidates appointed as Assistant Professors, participation in the Lecturer Training Programme (Universitetspædagogikum) is planned as part of the appointment.

 

Appointment to the positions requires academic qualifications at PhD level and in accordance with the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

 

What we offer

You will become part of a growing department with a unique opportunity to make a significant academic and professional impact.

Among other things, we offer:

  • the opportunity to help shape new educational programmes from the ground up

  • a strong research-based university environment

  • close integration of research, clinical practice, and teaching

  • excellent opportunities for academic career development

  • the opportunity to contribute to the establishment and development of the Research Unit APEX

  • an engaged and ambitious collegial environment with a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and innovation.

About the department

The Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) aims to advance and disseminate new knowledge within dentistry through excellent research, research-based education in SDU’s new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, and close collaboration with the healthcare sector.

The Department will educate the next generation of dentists and dental hygienists through research-based teaching, modern simulation and clinical training, and close engagement with the wider healthcare system, supported by a strong international research environment of the highest academic standard.

Our vision is to create a strong, internationally oriented research and educational environment where clinical excellence, evidence-based practice, and interdisciplinary collaboration go hand in hand.

Application deadline

October 19, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Contact

Further information about the position may be obtained from Professor and Head of Research Torben H. Thygesen, tthygesen@health.sdu.dk, +45 22 34 13 64, or Acting Head of Department and Dean Jakob Grauslund jgrauslund@health.sdu.dk, +45 93 50 70 42.

Salary and terms of employment 

The applicants will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). 

The position as assistant professor or associate professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. 

In addition, a centrally agreed assistant professor or associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application 

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total): 

  • a motivation letter 

  • a detailed CV 

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma) 

  • a complete and numbered list of publications 

  • 3 for assistant professors, and 6 associate professors, scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file. 

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy 

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.   

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Assessment 

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process.  

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.  

Living and working in Denmark 

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.  

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark.  

Join us in shaping the future of dentistry

We are seeking ambitious colleagues who wish to contribute to more than teaching alone. We invite dentists with a passion for academic development, research, and education to join us in building a new academic environment and educating the oral healthcare professionals of the future.

Together, we are creating the foundation for Denmark’s newest Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and shaping the future of dental education and research.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.
