jobs.title: Inspector, Private Home Cleaning  - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
RengøringsAgenterne ApS is looking for a dedicated inspector for our private home cleaning department

Do you have an eye for detail, and do you thrive in a role where quality and great customer relations go hand in hand? Then you might be our new inspector.

RengøringsAgenterne ApS is a Nordic Swan Ecolabel certified cleaning and property services company based in Kastrup. We have more than 200 employees, run a 100% electric vehicle fleet, and won the Børsen Gazelle award in both 2023 and 2024. We provide cleaning for housing associations, businesses and private customers across Greater Copenhagen – and it is our private customers you will be working with.

About the job

As inspector in our private cleaning department, you will be the link between our customers and our cleaning teams. You will report to the company's owner and managing director and play a central role in making sure quality is spot on every single time.

Your main tasks will be:

•      Quality control – ongoing inspection of completed cleaning in our private customers' homes

•      Quality reports – documentation and follow-up on inspection visits

•      Customer contact and relations – dialogue with customers, handling requests and feedback, and building long-term customer relationships

•      Operational support – hands-on support for the daily operations of the private cleaning department

Other tasks within the scope and responsibility of the position may also occur.

We expect that you

•      Have experience from the cleaning industry, the service industry or a similar role with quality responsibility

•      Have a sharp eye for detail and high standards for quality

•      Are outgoing and service-minded and enjoy daily customer contact

•      Communicate confidently in Danish, both spoken and written, including for reporting

•      Work in a structured and independent way and can plan your own day

•      Hold a category B driving licence, as the working day involves driving between customers

Experience with quality control or inspection work is an advantage, but not a requirement.

We offer

•      A full-time position of 40 hours per week with a fixed monthly salary

•      Employment as a salaried employee (funktionær) under proper terms – any overtime is compensated with time off in lieu at a 1:1 ratio

•      Health insurance paid by the company

•      A company car for work use by agreement, and work clothing where the position requires it

•      An informal and busy working day in a growing company with short decision-making paths

•      Green values in practice: Nordic Swan Ecolabel certification and an electric vehicle fleet

Practical information

•      Workplace: Fuglebækvej 3D, 2770 Kastrup – with daily driving to customers across Greater Copenhagen

•      Working hours: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday between 8:00 and 17:00 (Friday until 16:30)

•      Start date: As soon as possible, or by agreement

How to apply

Send your application and CV via Jobnet or to privat@ren-agenterne.dk. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate – so send your application today.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to write to us at privat@ren-agenterne.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
Lvi-asentaja huolto ja saneeraustöihin
jobs.description:
Haemme toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen Lvi-asentajaa. Päivittäiset työtehtävät muodostuvat vaihtelevissa kohteissa lvi-huoltotöistä, remonttikohteista, saneeraustyömailla työskentelystä kuin myös uudistyömailla työskentelystä. Kuitenkin pääsääntöisesti huolto- ja remonttikohteiden parissa. Niin taloyhtiökohteissa kuin yksityisasiakkaiden luona sekä remonttialan yritysten kanssa. Myös urakkatyöt ovat mahdollisia.

Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkan ja kattavan työterveyshuollon, oman työauton käyttöösi, nykyaikaiset työkalut, rennon ja rempseän työyhteisön pienessä porukassamme. Lisäksi voit käyttää vapaa-aikanasi yhtiömme tiloja omiin pieniin hommiisi. Tarjoamme myös vuosittain henkilökunnallemme, niin liikunta kuin hierontapalveluja lahjakorttien muodossa.

Toivomme sinulta: Tarkkaa ja tarmokasta otetta työhösi sekä luonnollisesti hyvää ammattiosaamista. Hitsaustaito luetaan eduksesi. Ymmärrys lämpöpumppu- ja kaukolämpölaitteista luetaan myös eduksesi. Olethan valmis myös oppimaan uutta sillä pyrimme aina mahdollisuuksien mukaan myös tarjoamaan kouluttautumista henkilökunnallemme.

Paikka täytetään heti kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä meihin niin sovitaan haastatteluaika ja istutaan kahvin kanssa katsomaan että olisiko juuri sinusta meille tuleva asentaja. Meillä ei tarvitse pokkuroida vaan kohtaamme jokaisen haastateltavan omana itsenämme ja arvostamme jokaista hakijaa.

jobs.title: Skru på noe litt utenom det vanlige – vi søker mekanikere!
jobs.description:
Klar for en mekanikerjobb litt utenom det vanlige? Vi søker flere mekanikere til Kongeparken, både heltid, deltid, fast og sesong.

 

Enten du har bakgrunn fra bil, industri, landbruk, anlegg eller annen mekanikk, kan dette være noe for deg. Hos oss får du bruke erfaringen din på alt fra teknisk utstyr og attraksjoner til vedlikehold rundt omkring i parken. Hos Kongeparken får du en variert arbeidshverdag. Du vil jobbe med vedlikehold og reparasjon av parkens attraksjoner og tekniske utstyr, i tillegg til generelt vedlikehold og praktiske oppgaver rundt omkring i parken.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Service, vedlikehold og reparasjon av attraksjoner og teknisk utstyr
  • Feilsøking og mekaniske reparasjoner
  • Arbeid med blant annet hydraulikk, pneumatikk, girkasser, lager og transportbånd
  • Vedlikehold av småmotorer, golfbiler og gokarter
  • Generelt vedlikehold og praktisk arbeid i parken
  • Klargjøring og kontroll av attraksjoner
Vi ser etter deg som
  • Har erfaring med mekanisk arbeid, reparasjon eller vedlikehold
  • Har god teknisk og praktisk forståelse
  • Er løsningsorientert og liker en variert arbeidshverdag
  • Jobber selvstendig og godt sammen med andre
  • Behersker norsk og/eller engelsk

Fagbrev er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Relevant erfaring kan veie opp for manglende formell utdanning.

Vi tilbyr
  • Heltid eller deltid
  • Fast stilling eller sesongarbeid
  • En variert mekanikerjobb utenom det vanlige
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kollegaer
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver innen mekanikk og vedlikehold

Noe kvelds- og helgearbeid må påregnes i høysesongen.

 

Har du spørsmål om stillingen eller rekrutteringsprosessen?
Ta gjerne kontakt med Madeleine Skjeldal, rekrutterings- og bemanningsrådgiver i Servtech Personell. Vi bistår Kongeparken i ansettelsesprosessen og forteller deg gjerne mer om stillingen.

 

Mims@servtech.no

+47 980 89 378

 

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kongeparken er en familiepark på Ålgård i Rogaland, med et bredt utvalg av attraksjoner og aktiviteter for hele familien. Hvert år besøkes parken av gjester fra hele landet.

 

Bak den daglige driften står medarbeidere med ulik bakgrunn og kompetanse, som jobber med alt fra gjesteopplevelser og servering til drift, teknisk arbeid og vedlikehold. Det jobbes året rundt med å klargjøre, vedlikeholde og utvikle både attraksjoner og parkområder. For det tekniske teamet innebærer dette arbeid med blant annet attraksjoner, tekniske installasjoner, maskiner, kjøretøy og generelt vedlikehold i parken. Hos Kongeparken blir du en del av et godt arbeidsmiljø, med varierte arbeidsdager og en arbeidsplass litt utenom det vanlige.

jobs.title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:
- Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.
- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.
- Negotiating with external suppliers and service contract providers.
- Drafting of commercial documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Contract management: managing the commercial aspects of contracts, including the critical examination of offers and the handling of claims and disputes.
- Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60. Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 5A0090 - Procurement Professional
Job flexibility: Hybrid

Please visit the following page for more information about the position and application process: https://careers.cern/jobs/procurement-and-contracts-officer/

jobs.title: Lähihoitajan sijaisuus, Vammaispalvelut, Koskelan asumisyksikkö, Paimio
jobs.description:
Haluatko tehdä työtä, jossa jokaisella kohtaamisella on merkitys? Koskelan asumisyksikössä Paimiossa pääset osaksi lämminhenkistä työyhteisöä, jossa tuet kehitysvammaisten asukkaiden turvallista, sujuvaa ja arvokasta arkea. Etsimme pitkäaikaiseen sijaisuuteen lähihoitajaa vuoden 2026 loppuun saakka.

Tehtäväsi

Lähihoitajana olet tärkeä osa asukkaidemme arkea ja hyvinvointia. Työssäsi huolehdit asiakkaiden päivittäisestä ohjauksesta, hoidosta ja yksilöllisten tarpeiden toteutumisesta yhdessä sovittujen suunnitelmien mukaisesti. Kohtaat jokaisen asukkaan yksilönä ja toimit heidän osallisuuttaan tukien.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös lääkehoidon toteuttaminen lääkärin määräysten ja yksikön lääkehoitosuunnitelman mukaisesti sekä muu terveydenhuollon toteuttaminen. Työ sisältää syvästi kehitysvammaisten asukkaiden kokonaisvaltaista hoitoa ja huolenpitoa sekä mielekkään ja turvallisen arjen mahdollistamista erilaisten toimintojen avulla.

Työvuorot ovat sovittavissa, ja työ on kaksi- tai kolmivuorotyötä.

Koskelan asumisyksikkö on koti 12 kehitysvammaiselle aikuiselle, jotka tarvitsevat paljon tukea päivän eri toiminnoissa. Yksikössä vallitsee rauhallinen ja turvallinen ilmapiiri. Suurin osa asukkaista liikkuu avustettuna tai apuvälineiden avulla. Vuonna 2016 valmistunut Koskela tarjoaa viihtyisän, valoisan ja esteettömän työympäristön keskellä kauniita maalaismaisemia.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle
- Merkityksellisen työn kehitysvammaisten asiakkaiden parissa
- Lämminhenkisen ja osaavan työyhteisön tuen
- Moniammatillisen tiimin, jossa jokaisen osaamista arvostetaan
- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työvuorojen suunnitteluun
- Pitkäaikaisen sijaisuuden vähintään vuoden 2026 loppuun asti
- Rauhallisen, turvallisen ja nykyaikaisen työympäristön.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammatillinen perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteinen tutkinto.

Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemusta ja osaamista kehitysvammaisuudesta sekä valmiuksia kohdata asiakkaiden yksilölliset tarpeet. Hallitset asiakaskirjaamisen, kuntouttavan työotteen, apuvälineiden käytön sekä kommunikaation tukemisen ja ohjaustyön menetelmät. Lisäksi tunnet tarvittavaa lainsäädäntöä ja sinulla on IMO- ja YKS-osaamista.

Työskentelet sujuvasti sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä. Osaat tehdä tilanteen vaatimia ratkaisuja, omaat hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot sekä suhtaudut myönteisesti uuden oppimiseen ja toiminnan kehittämiseen.

Tehtävässä edellytetään suomen kielen taitoa.

Eduksi katsomme aiemman kokemuksen kehitysvammatyöstä, vaihtoehtoisten kommunikaatiomenetelmien osaamisen sekä suoritetut vammaistyön opinnot.

Tule mukaan tekemään arjesta turvallista, sujuvaa ja merkityksellistä. Odotamme hakemustasi Koskelan asumisyksikköön!
Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana ja täytämme sijaisuuden sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Ellekildeskolens SFO søger uddannet pædagog eller pædagogisk assistent med den rette profil
jobs.description:
Vi leder efter dig, som har en særlig evne til at skabe relationer til børn. Dig, som ser barnet bag adfærden, fornemmer behovene, før de bliver sagt højt, og som med ro, varme og tydelighed får børn til at føle sig betydningsfulde. Kort sagt du skal have ”det der”!

Du er fagligt dygtig, men bærer det let. Du skaber trivsel, deltagelse og udvikling omkring dig, og det ser næsten ubesværet ud. Måske har du erfaring med special pædagogik, eller måske er du særligt optaget af, hvordan alle børn kan lykkes i fællesskabet.

Hos os får du mulighed for at præge både SFO og skolehverdag gennem stærke relationer, spændende aktiviteter og tæt samarbejde med engagerede kolleger.

  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for specialpædagogik og inkluderende læringsmiljøer
  • Kan skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for børn med forskellige behov og forudsætninger
  • Er tydelig, nærværende og anerkendende i din tilgang til børn og voksne
  • Har mod til at sætte aktiviteter i gang og følge dem helt til dørs
  • Vægter et tæt samarbejde med kolleger, på tværs af fagligheder, højt

Vi tilbyder

  • En arbejdsplads med mulighed for at forme aktiviteter efter dine styrker

  • Et fællesskab præget af humor, engagement og handlekraft

jobs.title: Solution Engineer, Wave
jobs.description:
Cadmatic is a leading global developer of digital and intelligent 3D-based design, engineering, and information management solutions for the marine, process, and construction industries. Our journey started in the 1980s. Over the past decade, we have grown by 20 percent annually, and it's all about talent. We truly value our people – many stay with us for years, with an average tenure of 10 years. Today we have over 330 proactive, engaged, and growth-minded people in 20 countries around the world. Over 6000 customers are using our software solutions in 60 countries. In the marine industry, our technology supports around 40 percent of the worlds shipyards. We continue strong growth.

We are looking for a Solution Engineer to help marine industry customers get more value from their PLM solutions. In this role, you will configure, customize, and develop Cadmatic Wave to support customer-specific requirements and business processes.

You are based in Finland, Germany, or the Netherlands and can work remotely or in a hybrid model. The role includes regular visits to customer sites across Central Europe, giving you the opportunity to work closely with customers and support them in their day-to-day use of Cadmatic solutions.

What you will work on:

- Support technical deployment of Cadmatic Wave in customer environments.
- Develop customer-specific enhancements that extend system capabilities beyond the core product.
- Configure and customize Cadmatic Wave to align with customer workflows and business goals.
- Collaborate with clients and solution consultants to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
- Act as the technical point of contact, ensuring clear communication and trusted partnerships.
- Oversee system rollouts and data migrations, ensuring minimal disruption and data integrity.
- Provide valuable feedback to R&D based on customer insights and project experiences.

We wish you to bring:

- Bachelors or masters degree in IT, engineering, or a related field.
- Solid experience in PLM implementation, consulting, or software configuration.
- Experience in software customization, aligning solutions to client-specific needs.
- Knowledge in requirements engineering, creating requirement specifications and writing user stories.
- Proficiency in Python, SQL, and database management.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail.
- A customer-focused approach and an interest in solving practical business and technical challenges.
- Willingness to travel to customer sites when needed.

We are especially glad if you have:

- Hands-on experience with PLM solutions, CONTACT PLM seen as advantage.
- Know-how of industry business processes related to product/project
- Experience with API integrations, cloud-based PLM solutions, and data migration methodologies.
- Exposure to software deployment, integration methodologies, and custom application development.

Cadmatic as an employer:

- A stable, global company with a long history, strong future, and advanced software solutions.
- A friendly, supportive, and truly multicultural work environment where we succeed together.
- Autonomy, ownership, and trust: youre encouraged to do your best work and develop professionally.
- Competitive benefits and flexible working practices that support worklife balance.
- An engineerminded, peoplefirst culture — we take our work seriously but also enjoy ourselves along the way.

Join our growth journey!

Delight us with your application by 13 September. If you have any questions, feel free to contact our hiring manager Ankit Talati via email ankit.talati@cadmatic.com. Please note that we only accept applications submitted to our Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

We will share the salary range in the interview invitation with candidates who progress to the interview stage.

We believe in diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are committed to building a company culture where we cherish diversity and promote equity, and where everyone feels valued and respected. We firmly believe that success comes from building an inclusive company culture and providing equal opportunities for our People.

jobs.title: Data Center Build Manager (rakennuttajapäällikkö)
jobs.description:
**Nordecon Oy | Riihimäki, Finland | Permanent position**

We are building a data center in Riihimäki, designed from the ground up for demanding AI and high-performance computing workloads. The project is in full swing, with the first phases targeting production readiness by the end of 2026. Server rooms are built in phases, so there is work here for a long time to come. We are looking for a build manager to drive the project forward as the owner's representative.

This is not a site foreman role. Designers, contractors and equipment suppliers handle the execution. You own the whole: schedule, budget, contracts and the interfaces to the grid company, suppliers and authorities. You report directly to the CEO and get the opportunity to build a team around you as the project and operational phase require.

What you will do

- Own the project schedule, budget and overall delivery as the owner's representative

- Direct and coordinate contractors, designers and equipment suppliers

- Own the electrical infrastructure as a whole: grid company interface, transformer station, backup power and their commissioning

- Manage permit processes and cooperation with authorities (building control, inspections)

- Ensure occupational safety and regulatory compliance on site

- Drive commissioning inspections, acceptance and documented handover to the operating organization

- Report to management and assess resourcing needs for the build and operational phases


What we expect

- A relevant technical degree (e.g. construction, electrical or building services engineering) or equivalent competence gained through experience

- At least 8 years of experience in owner's side project management of industrial or technical facility projects

- Strong understanding of electrical infrastructure: grid connections, transformer stations, backup power, commissioning inspections

- Experience with construction contracts and contract management (YSE 1998)

- A track record of schedule and cost control in projects

- Knowledge of Finnish permit and regulatory processes

- Fluent Finnish is required, as contractors, the grid company and authorities work in Finnish. English is used in technical documentation.


As a person you are self-driven and firm. You take full ownership, keep contractors on schedule and see things through to the finish.

What we consider a plus

- A strong plus: experience with data center projects or environments, including redundancy, power distribution, cooling and availability requirements

- Experience with Tier-classified data centers or the Uptime Institute framework

- Familiarity with SFS 6001

- Fluency with scheduling tools (e.g. MS Project)

- Experience with facility maintenance after commissioning


What we offer

- Ownership of the entire project and a direct reporting line to the CEO.

- The opportunity to build a team around you: you assess and propose the hiring needs for the build and operational phases.

- We are primarily hiring for a permanent position, but we are open to a fixed-term contract as well. Since the rooms are built in phases and the operational phase follows, there is work in sight far into the future.


The work is done mainly on site in Riihimäki, but remote work is acceptable whenever it is possible.

jobs.title: Kundeserviceansvarlig til House-Tech
jobs.description:
– vær med til at bygge kundeservicefunktionen fra bunden

Om jobbet

House-Tech er i vækst, og vi søger nu en kundeserviceansvarlig, der får en central rolle i at opbygge og udvikle vores kundeservice.

Det her er ikke en klassisk kundeservicestilling, hvor du alene skal besvare mails og telefoner. Du skal selvfølgelig sikre vores kunder hurtig, kompetent og personlig hjælp – men samtidig får du ansvaret for at skabe strukturen, systemerne og processerne bag en moderne og effektiv kundeservice.

Du bliver den første dedikerede person i funktionen og får derfor stor mulighed for at præge, hvordan vores kundeservice skal fungere fremover. Du skal kunne se muligheder for forbedringer, omsætte dem til konkrete løsninger og sammen med vores udviklere være med til at automatisere og optimere arbejdsgangene.

Vi arbejder allerede med en høj grad af egenudviklede systemer, og derfor er der kort vej fra en god idé til en løsning i drift. AI kommer samtidig til at spille en vigtig rolle i vores kundeservice, og vi forventer, at du er nysgerrig på, hvordan teknologien kan bruges til både at skabe en bedre kundeoplevelse og gøre arbejdet mere effektivt.

På sigt forventer vi, at kundeservicefunktionen vokser, og du får mulighed for at blive den faglige drivkraft for de kommende medarbejdere.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver blandt andet:

  • Daglig kundeservice på mail og telefon

  • Sikre hurtige, kompetente og ensartede kundeoplevelser

  • Salg og rådgivning til både B2C- og B2B-kunder

  • Opbygge struktur og processer omkring kundeservice

  • Identificere flaskehalse, fejl og udviklingsmuligheder i kunderejsen

  • Udvikle og optimere vores kundeservicesystemer sammen med vores interne udviklere

  • Implementere og anvende AI i relevante dele af kundeservicen

  • Skabe overblik over typer af kundehenvendelser og arbejde systematisk med at reducere unødvendige henvendelser

  • Samarbejde med vores grossister omkring blandt andet levering, returneringer og reklamationer

  • Være med til at skabe fundamentet for et fremtidigt kundeserviceteam

Faglige kvalifikationer

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice og ved, hvad der skaber en rigtig god kundeoplevelse

  • Har god systemforståelse og hurtigt kan gennemskue arbejdsgange og sammenhænge

  • Har erfaring med at udvikle eller optimere processer og systemer

  • Er nysgerrig på AI og har lyst til at bruge teknologien aktivt i dit arbejde

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt og kan drive dine egne projekter fra idé til implementering

  • Har lyst til på sigt at være faglig sparringspartner og lære nye kolleger op

Har du erfaring med e-commerce, kundeservicesystemer eller produkter inden for el og VVS, er det en fordel – men ikke et krav. Produktkendskab kan vi lære dig.

 

Personlige kvalifikationer

Vi søger en kollega, der:

  • Er imødekommende, positiv og oprigtigt interesseret i at hjælpe kunderne

  • Tager ansvar og ikke venter på, at andre fortæller, hvad næste skridt er

  • Kan lide at udvikle og forbedre frem for blot at administrere eksisterende løsninger

  • Er åben, ærlig og ordentlig i samarbejdet med både kunder og kolleger

  • Trives med forandringer og kan lide, at der sker noget

  • Kan bevare overblikket og skabe struktur, når virksomheden vokser hurtigt

  • Har lyst til at få indflydelse og samtidig er klar til at tage det ansvar, der følger med

 

Om House-Tech

House-Tech er en dansk e-commercevirksomhed med base i Ringkøbing. Vi sælger produkter inden for blandt andet el, VVS, arbejdstøj og værktøj til både private og professionelle kunder.

Vi er i gang med at bygge en virksomhed med store ambitioner, hvor teknologi, automatisering, stærke systemer og en god kundeoplevelse er centrale elementer.

Organisationen er flad, beslutningsvejene er korte, og vi tror på, at de mennesker, der sidder tættest på opgaven, også skal have mulighed for at påvirke, hvordan den bliver løst.

 

Hvorfor er det attraktivt at arbejde hos os?

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • Stor indflydelse – du får mulighed for at bygge kundeservicefunktionen op og sætte dit eget præg på den

  • Frihed under ansvar – vi forventer selvstændighed og handlekraft og giver samtidig stor frihed til at løse opgaverne

  • Kort vej fra idé til handling – mange af vores systemer er egenudviklede, og gode idéer kan hurtigt omsættes til konkrete løsninger

  • En virksomhed i vækst, hvor funktioner og systemer hele tiden udvikler sig

  • Mulighed for fagligt ansvar og på sigt en central rolle i opbygningen af et større kundeserviceteam

  • En uformel arbejdsplads med godt sammenhold, højt tempo og en ordentlig tone

  • Mulighed for hjemmearbejde i mindre omfang

 

Hvordan ansøger jeg?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til mb@house-tech.dk.

Fortæl os gerne, hvorfor netop denne kombination af kundeservice, systemudvikling og optimering tiltaler dig – og giv gerne eksempler på noget, du tidligere har været med til at forbedre eller bygge op.

Processen

Når du har sendt din ansøgning, modtager du en bekræftelse på modtagelsen.

Vi har ingen fast ansøgningsfrist og indkalder løbende relevante kandidater til samtale. Stillingen bliver besat, når vi har fundet den rette.

Du er altid velkommen til at kontakte os, hvis du har spørgsmål.

 

Det praktiske

Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

Arbejdsstedet er Birkmosevej 18, 6950 Ringkøbing.

Vores faste telefontid er som udgangspunkt kl. 10.00–14.00, mens arbejdstiden derudover er fleksibel inden for rammerne af stillingen.

Der er mulighed for hjemmearbejde i mindre omfang.

 

Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt.

 

Vil du vide mere?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

CEO Morten Brændgaard
Mail: mb@house-tech.dk
Telefon: 24 22 61 21

jobs.title: Attaché at the Belgian Embassy in Oslo
jobs.description:
Offer / conditions:

  • Duration: 1 year contract (permanent contract possible afterwards)

  • A full-time contract (37,5 hours per week) will be offered at a salary (gross monthly salary) of 54.187,98 NOK / month (can be reviewed on the basis of documented and relevant experience)

  • A holiday entitlement of 26 days (already adjusted pro rota to the duration of the contract). In addition, the Embassy offers 14 public holidays throughout the calendar year including the period between Christmas and New Year.

  • Location: The Embassy is housed in a centrally-located building near Aker Brygge in Oslo and is easily accessible by public transport.

  • Closing date for applications: 6 September 2026 at 23:59.

About the Embassy of Belgium in Oslo

The Embassy of Belgium in Oslo is a small, dynamic team of professionals providing diplomatic and consular services in Norway and Iceland. The Embassy is committed to delivering high quality services to its stakeholders in the host countries as well as in Belgium, while actively promoting Belgium's interests and values.

About the Position

The Embassy of Belgium in Oslo is seeking to recruit a proactive and detail‑oriented Attaché working predominantly on political and economic files. The position requires a high degree of integrity, initiative and a hands-on approach. As the Embassy operates with a small team, the successful candidate should be comfortable working in a versatile role, enjoy taking responsibility, and be motivated by the diversity of tasks inherent to a diplomatic post.

Main duties and responsibilities

  • Monitor and report on political, economic and administrative/legal developments within the Embassy's jurisdiction, with particular attention to EU‑related matters, energy and security policy.

  • Collect, analyse and interpret information related to current Norwegian, and if necessary, Icelandic affairs; monitor local media and relevant social networks.

  • Draft analytical reports and summaries in French or Dutch.

  • Participate in and help organise official activities of the diplomatic post, including meetings, conferences, seminars, and receptions.

  • Develop and maintain a professional network on behalf of the Embassy by attending events, conferences and symposia organised by third parties.

  • Contribute to the promotion of strong bilateral relations and cooperation with the receiving States and relevant international organisations; assess and report on the perception of Belgium within these circles.

  • Develop and support the Embassy's social media activities to promote its priorities and amplify its public profile.

  • Maintain and update internal reference tools, including country or thematic reports, instructions, information on local legislation, contact lists and other relevant databases.

  • Provide back‑up support in consular matters, if required.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Education: A Master's degree or equivalent (five‑year university degree) in international relations, law, economics, political science, or a closely related field.

  • Languages: Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, and at least one of the following languages: French or Dutch, which are used for internal reporting. Knowledge of Norwegian is considered a strong asset.

  • Professional experience: At least 1 year of work experience in a governmental organisation, an international organisation, an NGO, a university or research institution, a media organisation, a think tank, a foundation, a diplomatic mission, a development agency, a civil society organisation, a policy or advocacy organisation, or a similar organisation with activities in public affairs, communications, research, international cooperation, or diplomacy.

  • Core competencies:

    • Ability to work under time pressure and meet strict deadlines;

    • Strong analytical, drafting and reporting skills;

    • Excellent interpersonal and networking skills, with the capacity to represent Belgium professionally;

    • Advanced knowledge of European or international affairs.

    • A good knowledge of Norwegian politics or economics is a strong asset.

    • Expertise in energy and/or climate policy is considered a strong asset.

    • Sound political judgement and discretion.

Application process

Conditions of Employment:

  • Legal status: Applicants must be eligible to live and work in Norway at the time of application.

  • Before an offer of employment can be made, candidates must provide proof a local Norwegian address so that if selected, it will appear on the contract offered.

  • Proof of educational qualifications and prior experience will be required at or after the interview stage of the process.

Application/recruitment process: please submit your application by email to oslo.jobs@diplobel.fed.be. Your application should include a concise motivation letter and CV (two separate PDF documents) in either Dutch or French and should be submitted by 23:59 on 6 September 2026 at the latest.

jobs.title: Global pmo - mro (sherman) f/h (H/F)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Electronics & Defense est une entreprise internationale de plus de 19 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, qui mobilisent expertises et esprit de corps pour concevoir des solutions de haute technologie dans les domaines de l'aéronautique, de la défense et du spatial. En combinant intelligence humaine et technologique, l'entreprise développe des produits et services pour les acteurs du monde civil et militaires, sur terre, en mer, dans le ciel et dans l'espace.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionContext

As part of the acquisition of the Actuation business from Collins Aerospace, Safran Electronics and Defense has engaged an important set of transfers of work projects on MRO activities. It consists in transferring into Safran shops the Actuation MRO activity carried out by 6 Collins Aerospace shops across the world.

In order to reinforce the structure and control of that complex project, a Global PMO MRO transfers position is opened.



Mission

The Global PMO - MRO Transfers is responsible for defining, implementing and steering the project management framework and practices for worldwide MRO transfers within the Transfer Factory.

The role provides central visibility and control of the transfer portfolio, ensures adherence to transfer standards and governance, and secure value creation deliverables.



Key Responsibilities

1. Secure worldwide project management

o Consolidate and monitor planning (including critical path and fever charts), budget, risks and progress reporting through the Transfer Factory.

o Assess and implement the methods and tools required to efficiently control MRO transfer projects centrally.

o Develop and maintain worldwide transfer KPI & dashboards providing visibility and focus on key areas / actions / risks.

o Drive continuous improvement and adaptation of project management tools as projects progress on the execution phase.



2. Enhance transfer execution standards

o Enhance and cross-fertilize transfer projects standards across project teams (local governance, management rituals, monitoring tools, ...)

o Ensure process compliance including FDR implementation and Gate Reviews.

o Strengthen and structure the relationship and interfaces with Collins.

o Assess Golden Rules deployment and monitor progress.

o Drive active risk management at worldwide project level, including SMS.



3. Control aftermarket synergies

o Refine and update ASA transfers synergies calculation

o Track and align synergies generation with the various MRO receiving sites and finance leads

o Steer other aftermarket synergies streams

jobs.title: Customer Success - Support & Training Specialist

jobs.description:
Position Overview: We are seeking a full-time Support & Training Specialist based in Copenhagen, Denmark. In this role, you will provide front-line technical assistance, software guidance, and application training to users of our clinical trial technology platform. Your primary responsibilities will focus on resolving user software inquiries, handling application data change requests, creating end-user documentation, and guiding platform onboarding. This role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to technical troubleshooting.

We are looking for candidates who are detail-oriented, responsive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. Ideal candidates will demonstrate a passion for customer service, the ability to execute tasks with precision, and excellent communication and documentation skills.

What You’ll Do:

● User Application Support: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for software users across Europe and globally, diagnosing and resolving application usage questions via ticket or email.

● System & Data Management: Process application data change requests with accuracy, verifying data integrity within the platform.

● User Onboarding & Training: Conduct virtual application walkthroughs and training sessions to ensure platform users understand system functionality and protocol-specific workflows.

● Technical Documentation: Create, update, and maintain user-facing help guides, application FAQs, training manuals, and application release notes.

● Incident Logging & Escalation: Track, document, and reproduce technical software issues reported by users, escalating system bugs to internal engineering teams when necessary.

● Quality Assurance: Verify system functionality post-updates and contribute to feedback loops for software usability improvements.

 

 What You’ll Need:

● Strong interest in user support, software training, or technical help desk functions.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain software features clearly to non-technical users.

● High attention to detail and strong organizational and problem-solving skills.

● Ability to manage incoming support tickets effectively in a fast-paced environment.

● Experience creating software documentation, user guides, or training materials.

● Bachelor’s Degree preferred.

jobs.description:
Sipoo on kasvava ja ketterä, kaksikielinen kunta pääkaupunkiseudun läheisyydessä. Sipoon kunnan arki- ja vapaa-ajan toimialan liikuntapalvelujen tehtävänä on ylläpitää ja kehittää kunnan liikuntapaikkoja ja virkistysalueita tarkoituksenmukaisen, monipuolisen ja turvallisen liikuntaharrastuksen ja vapaa-ajanvieton mahdollistamiseksi sekä innostaa kuntalaisia liikkumaan järjestämällä houkuttelevia ja matalan kynnyksen liikunnanohjauspalveluita.

Haluatko tehdä monipuolista ja merkityksellistä työtä liikunnanohjauksen parissa?

Haemme nyt Sipoon kunnan arjen ja vapaa-ajan toimialalle liikuntapalveluihin

LIIKUNNANOHJAAJAA vakinaiseen työsuhteeseen 1.10.2026 alkaen tai aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.

Liikunnanohjaajana päätehtäviisi kuuluvat:

- liikunnanohjaus kaikille ikäryhmille
- liikuntaneuvonta
- liikuntaryhmien ohjaaminen (vesiliikunta-, erityisliikunta- ja senioriryhmät)
- varhaiskasvatuksen ja koulujen liikuntaan aktivointi
- leiritoiminnan toteutus koulujen loma-aikoina
- tapahtumien suunnittelu ja toteutus
- molemmilla kotimaisilla kielillä viestintä, (asiakasviestintä sekä verkkosivujen päivitys ja some-viestintä)

Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä liikuntakoordinaattorin kanssa. Teet yhteistyötä myös monialaisesti kunnan eri toimialojen, Itä-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen ja kolmannen sektorin vapaa-ajantoiminnan järjestäjien kanssa.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena tehtävään on soveltuva alempi korkeakoulututkinto tai liikunnanohjauksen perustutkinto tai vastaava liikunta-alan koulutus.
Tehtävien menestyksekäs hoitaminen edellyttää kokemusta liikunnan ohjaamisesta eri kohderyhmille. Lisäksi edellytämme toisen kotimaisen kielen hyvää kirjallista ja suullista osaamista sekä toisen kotimaisen kielen vähintään tyydyttävää kirjallista ja suullista osaamista.

Hakijalta odotamme lisäksi asiakaslähtöistä, aikaansaavaa ja oma-aloitteista asennetta sekä innostavaa otetta matalan kynnyksen liikuntaan. Arvostamme kehittävää ja positiivista työasennetta, hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja IT-taitoja sekä organisointikykyä.
Eduksi luetaan kokemus liikuntaneuvonnasta, erityisliikunta- ja senioriliikuntaryhmien ohjauskokemus sekä pätevyys uimakoulujen ohjaamiseen, hyvät verkostotyöskentelytaidot sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuus.

Palkkaus ja työsuhteen ehdot määräytyvät kunnallisen henkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen KVTESin mukaisesti, tehtäväkohtainen tasopalkka on 2676,40e/kk. Työ sisältää säännöllisesti 1-2 kertaa viikossa iltatyötä ja satunnaisesti viikonlopputöitä.Tehtävässä noudatetaan 6 kk:n koeaikaa. Valitun on esitettävä hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilastaan.

Tarjoamme sinulle kaksikielisen kunnan nykyaikaisen ja eteenpäin pyrkivän, reilun työyhteisön, monipuolisia työtehtäviä ja mielenkiintoista yhteistyötä myös kolmannen sektorin vapaa-ajantoiminnan järjestäjien kanssa.

Jätä hakemuksesi ja CV:si ohessa olevan linkin kautta 10.9.2026 klo 16.00 mennessä tai kotisivuillamme www.sipoo.fi/rekry. Alkuperäiset opinto- ja työtodistukset esitetään mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the  opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 5+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Native level Japanese, business level English




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role:

Join our FDE team and work directly with some of the world's largest organizations to turn their most ambitious ideas into production applications on Replit. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll partner closely with customers to understand their technical and business needs, architect solutions, and build the integrations and applications required to deploy Replit successfully within complex enterprise environments.

This is a deeply technical and hands-on role. You won’t just advise customers on what to build—you’ll build alongside them. You’ll take applications from initial idea and prototype through deployment and production, navigate complex enterprise environments, and solve the technical challenges that emerge when AI-powered software development meets real-world infrastructure, data, security, and organizational constraints.



You will:

 - Build with Customers: Embed with strategic enterprise customers to design and build high-impact applications and AI-powered workflows on Replit, taking projects from initial concept through production deployment.

 - Architect Enterprise Solutions: Design secure, scalable architectures that connect Replit with customers’ existing systems, data, APIs, identity providers, and infrastructure.

 - Integrate with the customer's stack: SSO, data warehouses, internal APIs, and SaaS systems.

 - Own Technical Deployments: Serve as the technical owner for complex enterprise implementations, identifying blockers, debugging issues, and driving projects through to successful production adoption.

 - Bridge Customers and Product: Develop a deep understanding of how enterprises use Replit and translate field insights, technical constraints, and recurring customer needs into actionable feedback for Replit’s product and engineering teams.

 - Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other Engineering teams to deliver high-quality experiences

 - Ship quickly and iterate based on customer feedback and usage data

 - Turn field patterns into templates, playbooks, and product requirements. Ship the best patterns back to the platform.



Required skills and experience:

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience building and deploying production software

 - Strong programming skills and the ability to quickly understand and work across unfamiliar codebases, APIs, and technical environments

 - Hands-on work with LLM applications in production: retrieval, tool calls, and evals.

 - Experience designing and owning complex technical systems from architecture through production

 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and independently drive technical projects to completion

 - Strong technical communication skills and experience working directly with customers, partners, or cross-functional stakeholders

 - Ability to translate business requirements and customer problems into pragmatic technical solutions



Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, consulting, or another highly technical customer-facing role

 - Experience building and deploying AI-powered applications, agents, or developer tools

 - Experience with modern cloud infrastructure, application deployment, databases, APIs, authentication, and enterprise integration patterns

 - Experience integrating software into complex enterprise environments, including identity and access management, internal data sources, APIs, and existing developer infrastructure



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Finance Systems & Compliance
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead the systems, data, and process work behind how we bill, recognize revenue, close the books, and prove our controls work.



You won't be writing the code or drawing the architecture; you'll be deciding what gets built, in what order, and why it matters. This is a role for someone who wants to understand a business well enough to change how it runs: learning the objectives, processes, and system flows end to end, then shaping them into strategic technical programs with real owners, deliberate sequencing, and decisions that hold up under audit. You'll sit between Finance and Accounting on one side and Engineering, Data, and Product on the other, and you'll be accountable for making new revenue streams operable and auditable, from a pricing model on a slide to a billed invoice, a booked journal entry, and a control that passes testing.



You'll report to the Lead Technical Program Manager for Data, Biztech & AI Transformation, within EPD. You'll get high-level direction and clear priorities from your manager, and independent ownership of how the work actually gets delivered. You'll bring engineering-side rigor and platform thinking to finance problems, and work as part of a team modernizing how the whole company operates.



Most of your time will go to three things: making new product and pricing launches work end to end in the finance stack, running the platforms and data flows behind quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and driving the IT general controls (ITGC) program so controls are designed into systems up front rather than retrofitted after go-live.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Act as Finance's technical counterpart on new product, pricing, and packaging launches, translating commercial models into requirements across order capture, rating and billing, tax, revenue recognition, and downstream reporting, and defining what "revenue-ready" means before go/no-go: who owns each piece, what's actually done versus asserted, and which risks are still cheap to fix

 - Broker the trade-off when a launch date and systems reality don't line up: a scoped manual workaround with an owner, a cost, and an expiration date, plus the path to the automated version. Then close the loop after launch on billing accuracy, exception rates, where revenue landed, whether the new controls actually operate, and what must be true to do this again at 10x volume

 - Independently own delivery and multi-quarter roadmaps for your finance systems programs, including ERP, billing and subscription management, CPQ, revenue subledger, procurement, and the reporting layer on top. Run the working groups that deliver them across Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Data, and Security, with clear accountability and updates leadership can read in two minutes

 - Run the operating rhythm: intake and prioritization, decision logs, early risk escalation, and a small set of metrics that show whether the work is actually improving anything, and flag early when committed scope and capacity don't line up

 - Map current-state processes and data lineage end to end and go after the breaks: reconciliation gaps, recurring manual journal entries, spreadsheets doing load-bearing work, competing sources of truth for the same metric. Partner with Data Engineering on the definitions and data contracts that let finance metrics tie cleanly to source systems, and hold the line when teams drift

 - Drive ITGC workstreams across in-scope financial systems: logical access and segregation of duties, change management, SDLC and CI/CD pipelines, job scheduling, and data interfaces. Partner with Internal Audit on scoping and control design, with a named owner for every control

 - Facilitate designing controls into new systems, systems changes, and launches before go-live with Controllership, Internal Audit, and Engineering, and serve as the systems-side point of contact for internal and external audit on ITGC walkthroughs and testing, translating between control language and engineering language, and driving deficiencies through root cause, named owners, evidence, and validation that the fix holds

 - Build AI-assisted workflows that expand what the teams around you can cover, and hold them to real standards: a defined task, a way to evaluate output quality, explicit human review gates on anything touching financial reporting, and documentation so someone else can run it




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 -  5+ years in technical program management, business systems, finance transformation, or a related field, with substantial time on finance or revenue systems; public-company or IPO-track experience is a strong plus

 - Working fluency in finance operations; you don't need to be an accountant, but you should hold your own on quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and know why revenue recognition is not the same as billing

 - Hands-on ITGC program experience across access, change management, and IT operations for in-scope financial systems, plus practical SOX knowledge. You understand how ITGC reliance determines what auditors will accept from automated controls and system-generated reports, can tell a key control from a non-key one, know where ITACs fit alongside ITGCs, and have been through remediation and audit cycles rather than only reading about them

 - AI-native operating mindset; this is a core requirement for this role. You already use AI to draft requirements, synthesize status, triage intake, and assemble evidence packages, and you share the patterns so others work differently because of what you built

 - A track record of independently delivering technical programs end to end, ideally transformation work such as system modernization, a large-scale migration, or an ERP or billing platform implementation, and turning messy or incomplete inputs into a concrete plan with owners and dates; you're pulled into problems before they're scoped and you're as useful advising a controller on process design as an engineering lead on sequencing

 - Working understanding of data lifecycle and analytics tooling, and real experience running change management for business systems, not just launching them

 - Influence without authority and a bias toward closure. You have no direct reports, so you work through credibility and clear reasoning, knowing when to push and when to escalate; you chase ambiguous items to a decision, will reopen the uncomfortable question a week before launch, and communicate clearly with Director/VP+ stakeholders, including when the news is bad




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Hands-on experience working in enterprise billing, ERP, and revenue systems such as NetSuite, Stripe, or comparable tools, with an understanding of how orders, invoices, and revenue data flow between them

 - Experience supporting an IPO readiness or first-year SOX program, including standing up ITGCs from scratch

 - CISA, CIA, or equivalent certification, or equivalent time embedded on an IT audit team

 - Experience building internal tooling or agents on a workspace platform rather than only configuring vendor systems

 - Process mapping rigor: Hands-on experience mapping and improving business processes through journey maps, service blueprints, operating models, and SOPs.

 - AI-native builder mindset: Experience designing or building with AI assistants and agents, workflow automation, or internal tooling — including prompt design, tool selection, and evaluation for quality, reliability, and edge cases. This role requires AI fluency.

 - Lightweight automation ability: Comfort building with Notion custom agents and automations, structured skills, and integrations across systems (APIs, webhooks, connectors). Hands-on preferred.

 - Clear communication and stakeholder judgment: Ability to convey design intent using whatever artifact fits the problem, and to present and defend tradeoffs across multiple tools and teams.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff, CRO
Data Quality Officer (M/F)
jobs.description:
BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

We are seeking a highly motivated, rigorous, and detail-oriented Data Quality Officer to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for our Data Quality Framework, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of our data across systems and processes. This role is critical in supporting enhancing our data-driven decision-making capabilities.

Your next challenge:

• Collaborate with Data Owners, Data Stewards, and IT teams to ensure continuous improvement of data quality standards.
• Develop AI-powered agents to generate, maintain, and optimize Data Quality rules.
• Automate Data Quality monitoring, issue detection, root cause analysis, and remediation workflows.
• Integrate Data Quality processes with Data Governance and Metadata Management platforms.
• Leverage Generative AI and Microsoft Copilot technologies to increase productivity and automate repetitive activities.
• Define KPIs and dashboards to measure Data Quality performance and automation benefits.
• Support the data stewards in the design of Data Quality Rules
• Build data quality dashboards, monitor and report on data quality metrics.
• Monitor the Data Quality Register and follow up on remediation plans.
• Implement data quality rules.
• Design and implement data quality standards, policies, and procedures.
• Maintain documentation of data quality processes and procedures.
• Conduct regular data quality assessments and audits to ensure compliance with data governance policies.
• Provide training and support to staff on data quality best practices and tools.
• Stay up-to-date with industry best practices and emerging trends in data quality management.

Your skills:

• Master's degree in Data Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance or a related field.
• Proven experience in data quality management, data governance, or a similar role within the banking or financial services industry.
• Technical knowledge (SQL or Python).
• Proactive, innovation-oriented mindset.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Experience with workflow automation platforms and low-code solutions.
• Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI concepts.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

jobs.title: Junior Fund Accountant (m/f)
jobs.description:
Junior Fund Accountant

The role is an entry level accounting-focused and will involve assisting our Fund accounting team in accounting and financial reporting for portfolio of funds and other structures mainly in the private equity and real estate sector. The individual will liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, assistance with periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and other day to day functions. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall senior fund accountants and manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting and bookkeeping of funds and SPVs (posting of invoices, interest and accruals etc.)
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and maintain all supporting documentation
• Respond to client queries and participate in client calls as required
• Assist senior team members in preparation of financial statements, using Lux GAAP and IFRS
• Assist senior team members in populating consolidation workings and intercompany eliminations
• Assist and in some cases in charge of regulatory reporting deliverables such as BCL reporting, CSSF reporting etc.

jobs.description:

Job ID: 10498640 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Amazon's Inbound Long Term Planning team owns the topology framework that decides what the EU inbound network looks like in 2–3 years: which node types we build, where we place them, how they interact, and what inventory configuration they unlock. This role owns a critical slice of that framework - taking speed ambitions and placement targets and working backwards into the physical network design across 1DCs, RDCs, and IXDs that makes them achievable. It's the kind of problem where getting the answer right saves hundreds of millions of dollars; getting it wrong means we either over-invest or structurally cap our speed ceiling for years.

You'll work at the intersection of network topology, inventory science, and capital allocation - partnering deeply with Finance, IIPO, AIM, and business teams to determine the optimal long-term node configuration that delivers placement targets per outbound node type and selection cohort. This is a single-threaded role with high ambiguity and regular exposure to senior leadership across SCOT, Operations, and Finance.

Key Job Responsibilities

- Own the long-term inbound topology framework - determine the optimal combination of node types, locations, and capacities that achieves placement targets at minimum total cost.

- Define network configuration per selection cohort - decide velocity demarcations between node types, regional zoning, and upstream storage share. Know when the model breaks and why.
- Build the multi-year inbound build plan - sequence node launches, size them against volume trajectories, and own the placement and inventory commitments that justify the investment.
- Resolve structural trade-offs that don't have clean owners. Frame options, quantify impact, and drive decisions when priorities across teams or geographies conflict.
- Align senior leadership to  single answer. Write the strategy documents that SCOT, Finance, IIPO, and Operations commit to. When priorities diverge, you reconcile.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in supply chain

- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Description

Category Manager for MHE Lifecycle is a part of GPO – Global Procurement Organization and represents a key global role responsible for managing the procurement of MHE Lifecycle services, serving Amazon's operations and internal customers (predominantly RME – Reliability and Maintenance Engineers). This role focuses on Spare Parts, Hotline Services, and Maintenance Activities. Supporting the end-to-end post site launch needs of Amazon's Material Handling Equipment

This global role manages important spend of around $120M across 10+ global suppliers in NA, INTL (EU incl. UK), APAC (incl. Australia), MENA, and LATAM regions, covering all Amazon business lines. Category Manager is managing top suppliers and partnering with the key internal customers with high visibility to RME and GPO Leadership.

Key job responsibilities

The MHE Lifecycle portfolio is complex and diversified, requiring close cooperation with multiple supplier types (MHE Integrators, Spare Parts Manufacturers, Distributors, Repair Providers, and Service Contractors). The role plays an important part in optimizing OPEX spending for RME by driving Cost Reduction and Cost Avoidance initiatives across all three pillars.

Spare Parts

- Supporting and implementing the sourcing strategy for spare parts including direct sourcing from manufacturers and distributors.
- Managing supplier relationships and performance for assigned spare parts suppliers.
- Regular and Project Specific Commercial terms negotiations for spare parts.
- Contributing to the Recommended Spare Parts List (RSPL) process improvement and catalog optimization.
- Supporting Supply Chain Risk Assessments for spare parts with newly awarded MHE Integrators for greenfield sites.
- Developing AI Tools to optimize procurement activities for spare parts.

Hotline Services

- Managing hotline support contracts with MHE Integrators and service providers.
- Tracking and optimizing SLA performance and response times.
- Supporting contract negotiations and renewals for hotline support agreements.
- Coordinating escalation processes with suppliers in partnership with RVM and RME Field teams.

Maintenance Activities

- Managing procurement of preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective maintenance contracts.
- Supporting Prime & Peak onsite support sourcing and contract management.
- Driving standardization of maintenance service scopes and pricing models across regions.
- Monitoring supplier performance against maintenance KPIs and SLAs.

A day in the life

The key activities of the Category Manager include:

A. Executing sourcing strategies for MHE spare parts, hotline, and maintenance services.
B. Managing supplier performance and SLA compliance across the MHE lifecycle portfolio.
C. Analyzing spend data and preparing cost reduction business cases for leadership review.
D. Regular (Annual/Quarterly) and project based price, lead times and other commercial terms negotiations refection in Coupa Catalogues.
E. Coordinating with RME Field & RVM teams on daily requests, escalations, and ticket resolution
G. Supporting contract negotiations and renewals for assigned suppliers
G. Contributing to process improvements in spare parts reception, catalog management, and procurement workflows
H. Preparing reporting and dashboards for category KPIs and supplier performance metrics

About the team

The role reports to the Global Life Cycle Category Lead. Key business partners include: MHE Equipment and Service Suppliers, Reliability and Maintenance Engineers (RME Central and Field Teams, ELM - Early Life Management, RVM - RME Vendor Management, Automation Engineers), and TVM - Technical Vendor Management.

- Bachelor's degree

- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
